sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: The marketing team must submit the quarterly budget report ______ Friday afternoon.

explanation.title: 介系詞（時間）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在（期限）之前」須用 **by**（表示動作在該時間點之前完成，強調期限）。(A) at 用於精確時間點（如 at 3 p.m.），不表示期限；(C) on 用於特定日期或星期，也不表示「之前」；(D) since 表示「自從」，須搭配完成式，句意不合。

questions.stem: Ms. Rodriguez ______ as the regional sales manager for nearly eight years before she was transferred to headquarters.

explanation.title: 時態（過去完成式）
explanation.analysis: 句中有 before 引導的過去時間子句（she was transferred），表示「在轉調之前，已經擔任經理職務長達八年」，須用**過去完成式** had + p.p. 來表示「過去的過去」。(A) serves 為現在式，時態不合；(B) served 為簡單過去式，無法表達「持續到某過去時間點之前」的意涵；(C) has served 為現在完成式，應搭配現在的時間點，而非過去的 before 子句。

questions.stem: The new employee handbook, ______ was distributed last Monday, outlines all company policies.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞
explanation.analysis: 空格前為逗號，引導**非限定用法的關係子句**，先行詞為 the new employee handbook（物），須用 **which**。(A) that 不可用於非限定用法（有逗號時不可用 that）；(B) what 本身已包含先行詞，不可再接先行詞；(D) who 只能指人，先行詞為物不合。

questions.stem: Customers can now track their shipments ______ using the updated mobile application.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾動詞 track（可以更方便地追蹤），須用**副詞** conveniently。(A) convenient 為形容詞；(B) convenience 為名詞；(D) convenienced 非常見詞形，且動詞用法不合句意。

questions.stem: ______ the sudden increase in raw material costs, the factory managed to keep production on schedule.

explanation.title: 介系詞片語 vs. 連接詞
explanation.analysis: 空格後接的是名詞片語（the sudden increase...），須用**介系詞** despite（儘管，後接名詞）。(A) Although 與 (C) Because 及 (D) Unless 皆為連接詞，須接「主詞+動詞」的子句，不可直接接名詞片語。句意上也是「儘管成本上升」符合轉折語意，despite 最適合。

questions.stem: The contract, ______ by both parties last week, will take effect on August 1.

explanation.title: 分詞（過去分詞作形容詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格與逗號間為插入的分詞片語，修飾主詞 the contract。合約與「簽署」之間為**被動關係**（合約被簽署），須用**過去分詞** signed。(A) sign 為原形動詞，不可單獨作修飾語；(B) signing 為現在分詞，表示主動或進行中，語意不合（合約不會主動簽署）；(D) to sign 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞構句的用法。

questions.stem: All interns who wish to ______ the training program must complete an application form.

explanation.title: 不定詞
explanation.analysis: wish to + **原形動詞**為固定用法，表示「希望做某事」。(B) joining 為動名詞，不可接在 to 後面作此用法；(C) joined 為過去式；(D) joins 為第三人稱單數現在式，皆不符合 to 後接原形動詞的規則。

questions.stem: The committee has not yet decided ______ to postpone the annual conference.

explanation.title: 名詞子句連接詞
explanation.analysis: decide 後接**名詞子句**作受詞，表示「是否」要延後會議，須用 **whether**（是否）。(A) what 表示「什麼」，句意不合；(C) that 引導的名詞子句表示「事實」，不能表達「是否」的疑問語氣；(D) if not 文法及語意皆不通順（if 雖可表示「是否」，但 if not 在此為錯誤用法）。

questions.stem: Of the two proposals submitted, the finance director prefers ______ that includes a detailed cost analysis.

explanation.title: 不定代名詞
explanation.analysis: 句中提到「兩個提案」（the two proposals），屬於**有範圍**且為**兩者之中剩下的一個**，須用 **the other**。(A) other 後應接複數名詞或不可數名詞，且無範圍；(B) another 表示「另一個」但無範圍限定（不特指剩下那個）；(D) others 為複數形式，與句子單數語境（偏好「那一個」提案）不合。

questions.stem: This year's profits were ______ higher than last year's, thanks to the new product line.

explanation.title: 比較級的強調用法
explanation.analysis: 修飾比較級形容詞 higher，須用可修飾比較級的副詞，如 **much**（…得多）。(B) very 只能修飾原級形容詞，不能修飾比較級；(C) many 用於修飾可數名詞複數，不可修飾形容詞比較級；(D) most 為最高級用法，與句中的比較級 higher 不搭配。

questions.stem: The manager asked her assistant to ______ the meeting minutes before sending them to the board.

explanation.title: 不定詞（ask + O + to V）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 ask + 受詞 + **to + 原形動詞**，表示「要求某人做某事」。(B) revision 為名詞；(C) revising 為動名詞；(D) revised 為過去式/過去分詞，皆不符合 to 後須接原形動詞的文法規則。

questions.stem: Not only did the company expand its overseas market, ______ it also doubled its annual revenue.

explanation.title: 對等連接詞（not only...but also）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 **not only...but (also)...**，表示「不僅...而且...」，且此句用了倒裝（Not only did the company...），後半句須搭配 **but** 呼應。(B)(C)(D) 皆無法與 not only 搭配構成正確的對等連接詞組合。

questions.stem: The consultant recommended that the firm ______ its outdated software immediately.

explanation.title: 假設語氣（建議動詞的 that 子句）
explanation.analysis: recommend 為**建議動詞**，其後 that 子句須用**「(should) + 原形動詞」**的假設語氣，故選 update。(A) updates 為第三人稱單數現在式；(C) updating 為動名詞；(D) updated 為過去式，皆不符合建議動詞後 that 子句的原形動詞規則。

questions.stem: Employees are encouraged to submit their expense reports ______ the end of each month.

explanation.title: 介系詞（期限）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在…之前」須用 **before**。(A) during 表示「在…期間」；(B) between 表示「在兩者之間」；(D) among 表示「在（三者以上）之中」，皆與「月底之前」的期限語意不合。

questions.stem: Having reviewed all the applications, the HR director ______ three candidates for the final interview.

explanation.title: 主要子句動詞時態（搭配句首分詞構句）
explanation.analysis: 句首 Having reviewed all the applications 為**完成式分詞構句**，表示「審核完所有申請」這個動作發生在主要子句動作**之前**，且與主詞 the HR director 為主動關係（HR 主任主動審核），故分詞構句本身寫法正確。空格位於主要子句，須為**主要動詞**，且應與分詞構句所暗示的過去時間點一致，故用**過去式** selected。(A) select 為原形動詞，不能單獨作主要動詞；(B) selects 為現在式，與句子描述的過去事件不合；(D) selecting 為現在分詞，不能作主要子句的唯一動詞。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：公司內部公告
sections.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Office Renovation Notice

We would like to inform all employees that the third-floor office space will undergo renovation starting next Monday. During this period, staff members currently ______ (16) on the third floor will be temporarily relocated to the fifth floor.

The renovation is expected to take approximately three weeks. ______ (17), the completion date may be extended if unforeseen issues arise.

**(18)** ______

Please remove all personal belongings from your desks by Friday. Facilities staff will not be responsible for any items left behind. If you have questions regarding the relocation, please contact the facilities office ______ (19) extension 245.

We appreciate your patience and cooperation during this transition.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 分詞作形容詞片語
explanation.analysis: staff members currently ______ on the third floor 為省略關代與 be 動詞的形容詞子句（= who are currently working），修飾 staff members，須用**現在分詞** working 表示主動進行的動作（員工「正在」該樓層工作）。(A) work 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(C) worked 為被動或過去式語意不合（員工不是被工作）；(D) to work 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞修飾的用法。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 轉折語意連接副詞
explanation.analysis: 前句說「預計三週完成」，後句說「若有突發狀況可能延長」，前後語意為**轉折**，須用 **However**（然而）。(A) Therefore 表示「因此」為因果關係；(C) In addition 表示「此外」為附加關係；(D) For example 表示「例如」為舉例關係，皆不符合此處的轉折語意。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The new office furniture has already been ordered from the supplier.
All employees are required to attend the annual safety training session.
Temporary desks and equipment will be provided at the new location.
The company's quarterly earnings exceeded analysts' expectations.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文談的是員工搬遷至五樓辦公之事，接續的句子應與**搬遷後的安排**相關，故選 (C)「臨時辦公桌與設備將提供於新地點」，承接上文的搬遷主題。(A) 談新辦公家具已訂購，與搬遷通知無關；(B) 談安全訓練課程，離題；(D) 談公司季度盈餘，與本文全無關聯。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（聯絡方式）
explanation.analysis:
表示「聯絡…分機號碼」，固定搭配為 contact + 對象 + **at** + extension（分機號碼），故選 at。(B) in 與 (D) with 不能與 extension 構成此固定搭配；(C) by 通常用於「透過某種方式/工具」（如 by phone、by email），不用於直接接續分機號碼。

### 短文二：電子郵件

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：電子郵件
sections.passage:
Dear Mr. Thompson,

Thank you for ______ (20) interest in our upcoming leadership workshop. We are pleased to confirm your registration for the session scheduled on July 15.

Please arrive at the training center by 8:30 a.m., as the workshop ______ (21) promptly at 9:00 a.m. Light refreshments will be provided during the morning break.

**(22)** ______

If you need to cancel or reschedule your attendance, kindly notify our office at least three business days ______ (23) advance so that we can offer your spot to another participant.

We look forward to seeing you at the workshop.

Best regards,
Training Department

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 所有格代名詞（形容詞性）
explanation.analysis: 空格後接名詞 interest，須用**所有格**修飾名詞，故選 your。(A) you 為受格/主格；(C) yours 為所有格代名詞（等於 your + 名詞，後面不可再接名詞）；(D) yourself 為反身代名詞，皆不符合空格後須接名詞的文法結構。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 時態（現在式，表排定行程）
explanation.analysis: 表示排定好的行程或時刻表，慣用**現在簡單式**表示未來確定發生的事，且主詞 workshop 為單數第三人稱，須用 begins。(A) begin 為原形動詞，與單數主詞不一致；(C) began 為過去式，與上下文的未來排程語意不合；(D) has begun 為現在完成式，語意為「已經開始」，與句意（將於九點準時開始）不符。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: Please note that parking is available in the lot adjacent to the building.
The company was founded over twenty years ago.
Our marketing team recently launched a new advertising campaign.
The workshop was postponed due to unforeseen circumstances.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文提到抵達訓練中心的時間與課程流程，接續句子應與**會場相關資訊**銜接，故選 (A)「請注意，停車場位於建築物旁」，屬於行前提醒的合理延伸。(B) 談公司成立時間，離題；(C) 談行銷團隊活動，離題；(D) 談工作坊延期，與本文語意矛盾（本文是確認報名，非延期通知）。

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 介系詞（固定搭配 in advance）
explanation.analysis: **in advance**（提前）為固定片語，故選 in。(A) at、(B) on、(D) for 皆不能與 advance 構成此固定搭配。

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章一：徵才廣告
sections.passage:
**Job Posting: Administrative Assistant**

Global Tech Solutions is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to join our growing office in downtown Seattle. The successful candidate will support the operations manager with scheduling, correspondence, and general office duties.

**Responsibilities:**
- Answer and direct phone calls
- Maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical
- Schedule appointments and manage the operations manager's calendar
- Prepare reports and presentations as needed

**Requirements:**
- At least two years of administrative experience
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

This is a full-time position with a competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance and paid vacation. Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to careers@globaltechsolutions.com by July 20. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?

options.text: To promote a new software product

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭即說明 Global Tech Solutions is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Assistant，全文圍繞徵才職缺的內容與應徵方式展開，故答案為 (B)「宣傳一個職缺空缺」。(A) 公司合併、(C) 新軟體產品、(D) 辦公室翻修皆未在文中提及。

questions.stem: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?

explanation.title: 細節題（反向排除）
explanation.analysis: 文章列出的職責為：接聽電話、維護檔案系統、安排行事曆、準備報告與簡報，並**未提及**「進行面試」（Conducting job interviews），故答案為 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 皆有在 Responsibilities 段落中明確列出。

questions.stem: According to the notice, what should interested applicants do?

options.text: Send a resume and cover letter by email

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to careers@globaltechsolutions.com，故答案為 (C)「以電子郵件寄送履歷與求職信」。(A)(B)(D) 文中皆未提及。

questions.stem: The word "shortlisted" in the last sentence is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis:
"shortlisted" 於此語境指「入圍/被列入候選名單」，即「被選中作進一步考慮」，故最接近 (B) selected for further consideration。(A) rejected（被拒絕）恰好相反；(C) newly hired（剛被錄取）程度超過原意（尚未錄取，只是進入面試名單）；(D) temporarily assigned（臨時指派）與原意無關。

### 文章二：客戶通知信

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章二：客戶通知信
sections.passage:
Dear Valued Customer,

We are writing to inform you of an important update to our online banking service. Beginning August 1, our mobile application will introduce a new two-step verification process to enhance the security of your account.

After this date, whenever you log in from a new device, you will be required to enter a verification code sent to your registered mobile number, in addition to your regular password. This additional layer of protection is designed to prevent unauthorized access to your account, especially in cases where your password may have been compromised.

Please ensure that your contact information, including your mobile number, is up to date in our system. You can verify or update this information by visiting the "Account Settings" section of the app or by contacting our customer service center.

We understand that this change may require a brief adjustment period, and we appreciate your understanding as we work to keep your financial information safe.

If you have any questions about this update, please do not hesitate to contact our support team at support@securebank.com or call 1-800-555-0199.

Sincerely,
Customer Security Team
SecureBank

questions.stem: Why did SecureBank send this letter?

options.text: To apologize for a recent service outage
To notify customers of a new security feature
To announce a change in interest rates
To promote a new mobile application

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭說明 we are writing to inform you of an important update...our mobile application will introduce a new two-step verification process，故答案為 (B)「通知客戶一項新的安全功能」。(A) 服務中斷道歉、(C) 利率變動、(D) 推廣新應用程式皆與文章主旨不符。

questions.stem: According to the letter, what will customers need to do when logging in from a new device after August 1?

options.text: Enter a verification code sent to their phone
Create a new password every time
Answer a series of security questions

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確說明 whenever you log in from a new device, you will be required to enter a verification code sent to your registered mobile number，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。

questions.stem: What are customers advised to do before the change takes effect?

options.text: Make sure their mobile number is up to date
Schedule an appointment with customer service

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 Please ensure that your contact information, including your mobile number, is up to date in our system，故答案為 (C)「確保行動電話號碼為最新資訊」。(A)(B)(D) 文中皆未提及。

questions.stem: The phrase "compromised" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "compromised" 於資安語境中指「（帳號密碼等）遭洩漏或暴露於風險中」，最接近 (B) exposed to risk。(A) improved（改善）、(C) permanently deleted（永久刪除）、(D) officially verified（正式驗證）皆與原意不符。

sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: All salary details must be kept strictly confidential ______ the Human Resources department.

explanation.title: 介系詞
explanation.analysis: 表示資訊「被限制在某範圍內部」須用 **within**（在…內部），符合「薪資資訊僅限於人資部門內部保密」的語意。(B) among 用於三者以上「之中」，不表示「限制於內」；(C) between 用於兩者之間；(D) into 表示「移動進入」的方向，不符合靜態的「在範圍內」語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: within / among / between / into 的語意區分；表示「範圍內部」的介系詞用法。
explanation.similarNote: 與題庫中測試 by / since / before 等時間介系詞的題目（如「must submit the quarterly budget report ______ Friday afternoon」）性質不同，本題考的是「範圍」介系詞而非「時間期限」，作答時須先判斷空格代表的是時間、地點還是範圍關係。

questions.stem: The onboarding coordinator ______ more than forty new employees since the department was reorganized last year.

explanation.title: 時態（現在完成式）
explanation.analysis: 句中的 since the department was reorganized last year（自從部門去年重組以來）是典型觸發**現在完成式**的訊號，表示「從過去某時間點持續到現在」的動作或狀態，故選 has trained。(A) trains 為現在簡單式，不能與 since 子句搭配；(B) trained 為過去簡單式，僅描述過去單一時間點的動作，無法表達「持續至今」；(D) will train 為未來式，與 since 引導的過去起點語意矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: since + 過去時間子句 觸發現在完成式；現在完成式表示「持續到現在」的動作。
explanation.similarNote: 類似題型會用 for + 一段時間、since + 過去時間點作為現在完成式的判斷線索，須注意本題的 since 子句本身是過去簡單式（was reorganized），但主要子句仍須用現在完成式，兩者時態不同、不可混淆。

questions.stem: The recruiter ______ conducted yesterday's interviews will share feedback with the hiring manager later this week.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞（限定用法）
explanation.analysis: 空格前的先行詞 the recruiter 為「人」，且此關係子句前**沒有逗號**，屬於**限定用法**，用來指出「是哪一位招募人員」，須用主格關係代名詞 **who**。(A) which 只能指物；(C) whom 為受格，但此處關係子句中缺少的是主詞（______ conducted...），須用主格；(D) whose 為所有格，句中並無「某人的某物」的所有關係。
explanation.grammarPoint: 限定用法 vs. 非限定用法關係子句；主格關係代名詞 who 用於先行詞為人且子句缺主詞時。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中另有多題測試「先行詞, ______ 動詞...」的**非限定用法**關係子句（逗號隔開，如 handbook, proposal 等題），本題刻意不加逗號、改考限定用法，作答時務必先觀察空格前後是否有逗號，才能判斷關係代名詞的可省略性與選用規則。

questions.stem: Job applicants are asked to describe their previous work experience ______ on the application form.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾動詞片語 describe...experience（描述經驗），須用**副詞** accurately 表示「精確地描述」。(A) accurate 為形容詞，不能修飾動詞；(B) accuracy 為名詞；(D) accurateness 並非常見詞形，且即使存在也是名詞，皆不符合修飾動詞的文法需求。
explanation.grammarPoint: 副詞修飾動詞的基本規則；-ly 結尾的副詞詞形變化。
explanation.similarNote: 與「track their shipments ______ using the app」考 conveniently 的題型結構相同（副詞修飾動詞），但情境與詞彙不同，作答關鍵仍是先判斷空格在句中的語法角色（修飾動詞、形容詞或名詞）。

questions.stem: ______ a number of employees requested more flexible working hours, the policy was rolled out company-wide.

explanation.title: 連接詞 vs. 介系詞片語
explanation.analysis: 空格後方為完整子句（a number of employees requested...，有主詞與動詞），須用**連接詞** Because 來連接原因子句。(B) Because of 為介系詞片語，後面只能接名詞或名詞片語，不能接完整子句；(C) Despite 與 (D) In spite of 皆為介系詞片語，且語意為「儘管」，與句意（因為員工要求而推行政策）的因果關係不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: because（連接詞，接子句）vs. because of / despite / in spite of（介系詞片語，接名詞）。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有多題測試 Despite / Although 的子句與介系詞片語辨析，本題改考「原因」關係的 Because，作答時須同時確認（1）空格後是子句還是名詞，以及（2）前後句的邏輯關係是因果還是讓步。

questions.stem: Job postings ______ on the internal portal are updated automatically every Monday morning.

explanation.title: 分詞作形容詞
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾名詞 Job postings，且「職缺公告」與「張貼」之間為**被動關係**（公告被張貼在內部入口網站上），須用**過去分詞** posted。(A) post 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(B) posting 為現在分詞，表示主動語意，語意不合（公告不會主動張貼）；(D) to post 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞修飾名詞的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 過去分詞作形容詞，表示被動或已完成的狀態，修飾其前的名詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The contract, ______ by both parties last week」（signed）屬於同一類分詞文法點，但本題省略逗號、直接將分詞置於名詞後方作後位修飾，句型結構不同，須練習辨識兩種分詞修飾名詞的呈現方式。

questions.stem: Full-time employees become eligible to ______ for the tuition reimbursement program after six months of service.

explanation.title: 不定詞
explanation.analysis: become eligible to + **原形動詞**為固定用法，表示「取得資格得以做某事」。(B) applying 為動名詞，不可接在 to 後方作此用法；(C) applied 為過去式；(D) applies 為第三人稱單數現在式，皆不符合 to 後接原形動詞的文法規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: be/become eligible to V（有資格做…）的固定搭配；不定詞 to + 原形動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與「wish to ______ the training program」（join）、「hoping to ______ for the scholarship」（qualify）屬於同一類「動詞/形容詞 + to + 原形動詞」題型，作答口訣是看到 to 後面直接判斷是否須接原形動詞。

questions.stem: The Human Resources office has not yet announced ______ the new benefits package will include dental coverage.

explanation.title: 名詞子句連接詞
explanation.analysis: announced 後接**名詞子句**作受詞，表示「是否」會包含牙科保險，須用 **whether**（是否）。(A) what 表示「什麼」，句意不合；(C) that 引導的名詞子句表示已確定的「事實」，無法表達「是否」的不確定語氣；(D) who 用於詢問「誰」，與句意不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: whether 引導名詞子句，表示「是否」的不確定語意；announce / decide / know 等動詞常接 whether 子句。
explanation.similarNote: 與「has not yet decided ______ to postpone the annual conference」（whether）為同類題型，皆是「尚未確定的公告/決定」搭配 whether 子句，作答時留意句中是否出現 not yet decided / not announced 等「尚未確定」的語意線索。

questions.stem: The finance team requires ______ additional information before approving the reimbursement request.

explanation.title: 數量詞（不可數名詞）
explanation.analysis: additional information 為**不可數名詞**，須搭配可修飾不可數名詞的數量詞 **some**。(B) many 與 (D) a few 只能修飾可數名詞複數；(C) few 同樣只能修飾可數名詞，且語意為「幾乎沒有」，與句意（財務團隊需要一些額外資訊才能核准）不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: some / much 修飾不可數名詞；many / few / a few 修飾可數名詞複數。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中另有以 many / much / a few / a little 測試可數與不可數名詞搭配的題目，作答關鍵是先判斷空格後方名詞是可數還是不可數，再決定數量詞的選用。

questions.stem: Among all the training programs the company has offered, this year's onboarding session is by far ______ comprehensive.

explanation.title: 最高級（the most + 形容詞）
explanation.analysis: 句首 Among all the training programs...（在所有訓練課程之中）為比較範圍的訊號，表示「在範圍內最…」須用**最高級** the most comprehensive。(A) more 與 (D) much 為比較級（或比較級的強調詞），僅適用於兩者比較，不適用於三者以上範圍的比較；(B) most 若不加 the，作副詞用時語意為「非常」，不符合此處「在所有課程之中最完整」的最高級語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: Among / Of all + 複數名詞 觸發最高級句型；the most + 多音節形容詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與「much/far/very 修飾比較級」的題型（如 much higher、far more effective）不同，本題的關鍵線索是句首 Among all，這表示比較對象為三者以上，須改用最高級而非比較級，作答時務必先確認比較對象的數量。

questions.stem: The mandatory training session ______ postponed due to a scheduling conflict with the board meeting.

explanation.title: 情態助動詞完成式被動語態
explanation.analysis: 句意為「對訓練場次的安排必然是被延後了（現在對過去情況的推測）」，須用**情態助動詞完成式被動** must have been postponed，表示「對過去已發生之事的高度確定推測」。(A) must 後須接原形動詞，不能直接接過去分詞；(B) must be 為情態助動詞現在式被動，僅適用於推測現在的狀態，與句中「因會議時間衝突」這個已發生的過去原因不合；(D) must having been 文法錯誤，having 不可接在 must 之後。
explanation.grammarPoint: 情態助動詞 + have been + p.p. 表示對過去事件的推測（被動語態）。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「情態助動詞 + 完成式」題型較少見於本題庫先前題目，需特別留意 must / should / may / might + have + p.p. 的組合方式，並分辨主動（have + p.p.）與被動（have been + p.p.）的差異。

questions.stem: The newly appointed manager will be responsible for both hiring ______ training junior staff members.

explanation.title: 對等連接詞（both...and）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 **both...and...**，表示「兩者皆…」，須用 and 呼應 both，故選 and。(B) or、(C) but、(D) so 皆無法與 both 搭配構成正確的對等連接詞組合。
explanation.grammarPoint: both A and B 的固定對等連接詞搭配。
explanation.similarNote: 與「not only...but (also)」的對等連接詞題型概念相同，皆須記憶固定搭配組合，作答時看到 both 就應直接聯想到必須搭配 and，無須逐一分析語意。

questions.stem: The Human Resources team is responsible for ______ all employee records strictly confidential.

explanation.title: 動名詞作介系詞受詞
explanation.analysis: be responsible for 為固定片語，**for** 為介系詞，介系詞後方須接**動名詞**作受詞，故選 keeping。(A) keep 為原形動詞，不可直接接在介系詞後；(C) kept 為過去式/過去分詞；(D) to keep 為不定詞，皆不符合介系詞後接動名詞的文法規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: be responsible for + V-ing；介系詞後接動名詞作受詞的規則。
explanation.similarNote: 凡是「介系詞 + 空格 + 名詞/受詞」的句型，且空格須為動詞的情況，幾乎都應優先考慮動名詞，題庫中「look forward to + V-ing」「worth + V-ing」等題型皆屬同一邏輯，須養成看到介系詞後空格直接聯想動名詞的反射。

questions.stem: All expense reports must be filed ______ the updated financial guidelines issued last quarter.

explanation.title: 介系詞片語（片語動詞搭配）
explanation.analysis: **in accordance with**（依照、符合）為固定片語，表示費用報告須「依照」財務準則辦理，語意通順。(B) regardless of（不論）、(C) contrary to（與…相反）、(D) apart from（除…之外）皆與「依照準則申報」的句意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: in accordance with（依照）為常見商用英文固定片語；片語介系詞的語意選擇須以上下文邏輯關係判斷。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「固定片語介系詞」題型不同於單純的時間或地點介系詞題（如 by / within / during），作答時須將整個片語視為一個單位去理解語意，而非只看單一介系詞本身。

questions.stem: ______ confidential employee information without proper authorization violates company policy and may lead to disciplinary action.

explanation.title: 動名詞作主詞
explanation.analysis: 空格為句子的**主詞**，且主要動詞 violates 為第三人稱單數現在式，須用**動名詞** Disclosing 作主詞（動名詞片語作主詞視為單數）。(A) Disclose 為原形動詞，不能單獨作主詞；(C) Disclosed 為過去式/過去分詞，不能作主詞；(D) Being disclosed 為被動語態的動名詞，語意變成「被揭露」，與句意（某人主動洩漏機密資訊）的主動語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 動名詞片語作句子主詞，其後動詞須用單數形式；動名詞的主動與被動形式（V-ing vs. being + p.p.）辨析。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「動名詞作主詞」題型與「Having reviewed all the applications, the HR director ______」這種**句首分詞構句**（修飾主要子句主詞的分詞）不同，前者的動名詞本身就是主詞，後者的分詞構句只是修飾語，主要子句另有主詞，作答時務必分辨空格在句中究竟是主詞還是修飾語。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：內部公告
sections.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Human Resources
Subject: Mandatory Compliance Training

We would like to inform all employees that a new mandatory compliance training program will begin next month. Employees currently ______ (16) to project teams that span multiple departments should coordinate their schedules with their supervisors in advance.

The training is expected to take two full days to complete. ______ (17), employees who are unable to attend the scheduled sessions may request an alternative date through the HR portal.

**(18)** ______

Please complete the online pre-training survey by the end of this week. The survey results will help us tailor certain sections of the training to specific departments. If you have any questions about the training schedule, please contact the HR office ______ (19) the internal helpdesk system.

We appreciate your cooperation as we work to strengthen our compliance standards.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 分詞作形容詞片語
explanation.analysis: Employees currently ______ to project teams 為省略關代與 be 動詞的形容詞子句（= who are currently assigned），修飾 Employees，且「員工」與「被分配」之間為**被動關係**，須用**過去分詞** assigned。(A) assign 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(B) assigning 為現在分詞，表示主動語意，與「員工被分配至專案團隊」的被動語意不合；(D) to assign 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞修飾的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞，省略關係代名詞 + be 動詞的用法。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「staff members currently ______ on the third floor」（working）結構相似，但語態不同：working 為主動（員工正在工作），assigned 為被動（員工被分配），作答時務必先判斷該名詞與該動詞之間是主動還是被動關係。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 轉折語意連接副詞
explanation.analysis: 前句說明「訓練預計耗時兩天」，後句說明「無法出席者可申請其他日期」，語意上為讓步/轉折關係，須用**Nevertheless**（儘管如此）承接上文並提出例外安排。(B) For instance 表示「舉例」；(C) As a result 表示「因此」的因果關係；(D) In other words 表示「換言之」的重述關係，皆不符合此處的轉折語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: Nevertheless / However 等轉折連接副詞，用於承接語意相反或帶有讓步意味的句子。
explanation.similarNote: 與「However」類轉折連接詞考法相同，但用詞不同，須熟悉 However、Nevertheless、Nonetheless 皆可表達轉折語意，避免只記憶單一詞彙。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The company's revenue exceeded projections during the last fiscal year.
Attendance records will be automatically updated once each session is completed.
The new cafeteria menu will be introduced starting next Monday.
All company vehicles must be inspected annually for safety compliance.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文談的是訓練無法出席者可申請其他場次，接續句子應與**出席／場次相關的後續處理**銜接，故選 (B)「每完成一場次，出勤紀錄將自動更新」，承接上文討論的出席安排主題。(A) 談公司營收，與訓練通知無關；(C) 談自助餐廳菜單，離題；(D) 談公司車輛安全檢驗，與本文全無關聯。
explanation.grammarPoint: 段落銜接題須依上下文主題一致性判斷，而非單純文法正確性。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「選出最適合插入的句子」題型，四個選項通常文法皆正確，作答關鍵在於**主題連貫性**，須通讀前後段落，排除主題無關的選項。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（透過某系統聯絡）
explanation.analysis: 表示「透過內部客服系統聯絡」，須用 **through**（透過），符合以某系統作為聯絡管道的語意。(B) at 通常用於精確地點或時間點；(C) since 表示「自從」；(D) among 表示「在…之中」，皆不符合「透過某系統」的語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: through 表示「透過（管道、方式）」；聯絡方式相關介系詞的語意選擇。
explanation.similarNote:
與模擬測驗一「contact the facilities office ______ extension 245」（at）不同，該題是接「分機號碼」用 at，本題是接「系統／管道」用 through，須依空格後方名詞的性質（號碼 vs. 系統管道）分別判斷介系詞。

### 短文二：電子郵件

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：電子郵件
sections.passage:
Dear Ms. Alvarado,

Thank you for confirming ______ (20) attendance at the upcoming annual performance review meeting scheduled for March 14.

Please bring a printed copy of your self-assessment form, as the meeting ______ (21) at 10:00 a.m. sharp in Conference Room B.

**(22)** ______

If you are unable to attend at the scheduled time, please notify your supervisor no later than two business days ______ (23) the scheduled meeting time so that an alternative slot can be arranged.

We look forward to discussing your progress with you.

Best regards,
Human Resources Department

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 所有格代名詞（形容詞性）
explanation.analysis: 空格後接名詞 attendance，須用**所有格**修飾名詞，故選 your。(A) you 為受格/主格；(C) yours 為所有格代名詞（等於 your + 名詞，後面不可再接名詞）；(D) yourself 為反身代名詞，皆不符合空格後須接名詞的文法結構。
explanation.grammarPoint: 所有格形容詞（your）用於修飾其後名詞，與所有格代名詞（yours）的差異。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「Thank you for ______ interest in our...workshop」（your）屬同一類所有格題型，作答口訣是看空格後方是否緊接名詞，若是則須選所有格形容詞。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 時態（現在式表排定行程）
explanation.analysis: 表示排定好的會議時刻表，慣用**現在簡單式**表示未來確定發生的事，且主詞 the meeting 為單數第三人稱，須用 begins。(A) begin 為原形動詞，與單數主詞不一致；(C) began 為過去式，與上下文「即將於上午十點準時開始」的未來排程語意不合；(D) has begun 為現在完成式，語意為「已經開始」，與句意不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 現在簡單式表示已排定的未來時刻表或行程；主詞動詞單複數一致性。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「the workshop ______ promptly at 9:00 a.m.」（begins）題型完全相同，皆是「排定行程用現在簡單式」的固定考點，遇到會議、班機、課程等時刻表語境時，優先考慮現在簡單式。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The company plans to expand into international markets next year.
Copies of last year's review will also be available for reference during the discussion.
The IT department recently upgraded the office Wi-Fi network.
Please note that the annual holiday party will be held in December.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文提到自我評估表與會議時間地點，接續句子應與**會議內容/準備資料相關**，故選 (B)「去年的考核紀錄副本屆時也將提供參考」，承接上文討論績效考核會議的準備事項。(A) 談公司海外市場拓展，離題；(C) 談辦公室網路升級，離題；(D) 談年末尾牙活動，與績效考核會議無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 段落銜接題須依上下文主題一致性判斷。
explanation.similarNote: 同題型解法與題目 18 相同，須排除與段落主題（績效考核會議安排）無關的選項，優先選擇能自然延續上下文邏輯的句子。

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 介系詞（期限）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在會議時間之前」通知主管，須用 **before**。(B) after 表示「之後」，語意相反；(C) during 表示「期間」；(D) since 表示「自從」，皆與「提前通知」的語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: before 表示「在…之前」的期限介系詞用法。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「notify our office at least three business days ______ advance」（in，固定片語 in advance）不同，本題改為 before + 名詞的直接期限用法，並非固定片語，作答時須注意介系詞後方接的是「advance」這個特定名詞還是一般的時間名詞。

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章一：內部職缺公告
sections.passage:
**Internal Job Posting: Employee Relations Specialist**

Meridian Business Group is currently seeking an Employee Relations Specialist to join our growing Human Resources team at the corporate office in Denver. The successful candidate will work closely with department managers to resolve workplace concerns and support a positive work environment.

**Responsibilities:**
- Investigate and mediate employee complaints and workplace disputes
- Advise managers on company policy and disciplinary procedures
- Assist in updating the employee handbook on an annual basis
- Coordinate exit interviews for departing staff

**Requirements:**
- A minimum of three years of experience in human resources or a related field
- Strong conflict-resolution and interpersonal skills
- Familiarity with employment law is preferred but not required
- Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, or a related discipline

This is an internal-only posting open to current full-time employees who have completed at least one year with the company. Interested employees should submit an updated resume along with a brief statement of interest to hr-internal@meridianbg.com by August 15. Selected candidates will be invited to a first-round interview with the HR director the following week.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of this posting?

options.text: To advertise an internal job opening
To introduce a new employee benefits plan
To report on quarterly financial results

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭即說明 Meridian Business Group is currently seeking an Employee Relations Specialist，全文圍繞內部職缺的職責與應徵方式展開，故答案為 (B)「宣傳一個內部職缺」。(A) 公司遷址、(C) 員工福利方案、(D) 季度財報皆未在文中提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題須掌握文章開頭段落的核心訊息，通常第一段即點出全文主題。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「What is the main purpose of this notice?」（B，宣傳職缺）為同類題型，兩者皆是徵才公告的主旨題，解題技巧相同：鎖定首段的目的句。

questions.stem: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?

explanation.title: 細節題（反向排除）
explanation.analysis: 文章列出的職責為：調查並調解員工申訴與職場糾紛、就公司政策與懲處程序提供主管建議、協助更新員工手冊、協調離職面談，並**未提及**「為新進員工協商薪資」（Negotiating salaries for new hires），故答案為 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 皆有在 Responsibilities 段落中明確列出。
explanation.grammarPoint: 反向排除題須逐一對照選項與原文條列內容，找出「未被提及」的選項。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?」為同類題型，皆須將 Responsibilities 清單逐條與四個選項比對，排除法是解此類題的關鍵。

questions.stem: Who is eligible to apply for this position?

options.text: Current full-time employees with at least one year of service

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 This is an internal-only posting open to current full-time employees who have completed at least one year with the company，故答案為 (C)「已在職滿一年的現職全職員工」。(A)(B)(D) 文中皆未提及或與原文不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須找出文中對應的關鍵句並精確比對選項用詞。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「應徵資格」細節題與「what should interested applicants do」（如何應徵）不同，須留意題目問的是「誰有資格」還是「該做什麼動作」，避免答非所問。

questions.stem: The word "mediate" in the first bullet point is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "mediate" 於職場糾紛語境中指「居中調解、協助解決」，故最接近 (B) help resolve。(A) ignore（忽視）與原意相反；(C) formally punish（正式懲處）程度不符，調解並非懲處；(D) permanently record（永久記錄）與原意無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 字義題須依上下文語境判斷詞彙的實際用法，而非僅依字典的字面意思。
explanation.similarNote:
與模擬測驗一「shortlisted」、模擬測驗二「complimentary」等字義題屬同一類型，解題技巧皆是將四個選項代入原句，選出語意通順且最貼近上下文邏輯的選項。

### 文章二：員工福利公告信

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章二：員工福利公告信
sections.passage:
Dear Team Members,

This is a reminder that the annual open enrollment period for employee benefits will run from October 1 to October 15. During this time, all employees have the opportunity to review and make changes to their health insurance, dental coverage, and retirement plan contributions for the upcoming year.

Employees who do not wish to make any changes to their current elections are not required to take any action; existing selections will automatically carry over into the new plan year. However, employees who wish to add a dependent, switch insurance providers, or adjust their retirement contribution percentage must submit an updated enrollment form through the HR portal before the deadline.

A series of informational sessions will be held in the main conference room on October 3 and October 8 to answer questions about plan options and any changes to premium rates for the coming year. Attendance at these sessions is optional but strongly recommended for employees considering changes to their coverage.

Please note that enrollment forms submitted after October 15 will not be processed, and employees who miss the deadline will automatically be enrolled in their current plan for another year. If you have questions about your benefits options, please contact the benefits team at extension 310.

Thank you for your attention to this important matter.

Sincerely,
Benefits Administration Team

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?

options.text: To announce a change in company leadership
To remind employees of the annual benefits open enrollment period
To introduce a new health insurance provider
To request feedback on employee benefits

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭說明 This is a reminder that the annual open enrollment period for employee benefits will run from October 1 to October 15，故答案為 (B)「提醒員工年度福利公開投保期間」。(A) 公司領導層異動、(C) 新健康保險供應商、(D) 徵求員工福利意見反饋皆與文章主旨不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題須掌握首段的核心目的句，通常以 This is a reminder that... 或 We are writing to inform... 等句型開頭。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗二「What is the main purpose of this letter?」（提醒員工年度公司旅遊活動）屬同一類「提醒信」主旨題，皆須鎖定首段的 reminder 語句。

questions.stem: What happens if an employee does not take any action during the enrollment period?

options.text: Their benefits will be automatically canceled
They will be required to attend a mandatory meeting
Their current elections will automatically carry over
They will receive a reduced benefits package

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確說明 Employees who do not wish to make any changes to their current elections are not required to take any action; existing selections will automatically carry over into the new plan year，故答案為 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須鎖定條件句（Employees who...）並精確對應其後果子句。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「若不採取行動會發生什麼」的條件式細節題，須特別留意原文中 if / who / unless 等條件連接詞後方的內容，避免誤將「須採取行動」的情況（新增眷屬、更換保險等）與「不須採取行動」的情況混淆。

questions.stem: What is recommended for employees who are considering changes to their coverage?

options.text: Attend one of the informational sessions
Submit a written appeal to management
Wait until the following enrollment period

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 Attendance at these sessions is optional but strongly recommended for employees considering changes to their coverage，故答案為 (B)「參加其中一場說明會」。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須找出 recommended / advised / suggested 等建議語意的關鍵句。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「What should employees do if they plan to drive themselves to the retreat?」為同類「建議/應做事項」細節題，解題時須鎖定文中明確給出建議或指示的句子。

questions.stem: The phrase "carry over" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "carry over" 於保險/投保語境中指「（原有選擇）延續、自動轉移至下一期」，最接近 (B) be transferred or continued。(A) be canceled（被取消）與原意相反；(C) be reviewed manually（被人工審核）與原意不符；(D) be reduced significantly（大幅減少）與原意無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 片語動詞（carry over）的字義題須依上下文判斷其引申意義。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗二「compromised」字義題同屬「片語/單字在特定語境下的引申義」題型，作答時須避免直接套用字面翻譯，應以上下文邏輯反推最合理的字義。

sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: The design team submitted the final ______ for the new product packaging yesterday.

explanation.title: 詞性（名詞作受詞）
explanation.analysis: 動詞 submitted 後須接**名詞**作受詞，且空格前有定冠詞 the 及形容詞 final 修飾，故選名詞 proposal。(A) propose 為動詞；(C) proposed 為過去式/過去分詞；(D) proposing 為動名詞，皆不符合 the final ______ 需為名詞的文法位置。

questions.stem: By the time the CEO arrives tomorrow morning, the staff ______ the entire conference room.

explanation.title: 時態（未來完成式）
explanation.analysis: 句型 By the time + 現在式子句，表示「到某未來時間點為止」，主要子句須用**未來完成式** will have + p.p.，表示「屆時已經完成」。(A) decorate 為原形動詞；(B) will decorate 為簡單未來式，只表示未來會做，未強調「屆時已完成」；(D) decorated 為過去式，時態不合。

questions.stem: The customer service representative who ______ your call yesterday has already forwarded your complaint to the manager.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞（先行詞為人）
explanation.analysis: 空格引導**限定用法關係子句**，修飾先行詞 the customer service representative（人），且子句中缺少主詞，須用**主格關係代名詞** who，並依句意（過去接的電話）搭配**過去式動詞** took。(A) take 為現在式，與過去語境（yesterday）不合；(C) taking 缺少助動詞不能單獨作子句動詞；(D) is taken 為被動語態，與句意（該員接了電話，主動動作）不合。

questions.stem: The negotiations between the two companies proceeded ______ despite the tight deadline.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾動詞 proceeded（進行得如何），須用**副詞** smoothly。(A) smooth 為形容詞；(B) smoothness 為名詞；(D) smoother 為形容詞比較級，皆不能修飾動詞。

questions.stem: ______ the manual carefully, the technician was still unable to fix the printer.

explanation.title: 連接詞（雖然）
explanation.analysis: 空格後接「主詞 + 動詞」的完整子句（the technician read the manual carefully，此處為分詞構句省略主詞與 be 動詞的簡化形式，但原句邏輯為讓步子句），須用**連接詞** Although。(A) Despite 與 (D) Due to 為介系詞，後面應接名詞或動名詞而非完整子句邏輯；(C) Because of 也是介系詞片語，且語意為「因為」，與句意（儘管讀了手冊仍無法修好）的**轉折**邏輯不合。

questions.stem: The invoice, ______ to the wrong department, was returned three days later.

explanation.title: 分詞（過去分詞作形容詞）
explanation.analysis: 逗號間的分詞片語修飾主詞 the invoice，發票與「寄送」之間為**被動關係**（發票被寄到錯誤部門），須用**過去分詞** sent。(A) send 為原形動詞；(B) sending 為現在分詞，表主動語意不合；(D) to send 為不定詞，皆不符合此處分詞構句的被動語意需求。

questions.stem: Applicants hoping to ______ for the scholarship must submit all documents by June 30.

explanation.title: 不定詞
explanation.analysis: hope to + **原形動詞**為固定用法。(B) qualifying 為動名詞；(C) qualified 為過去式/過去分詞；(D) qualifies 為第三人稱單數現在式，皆不符合 to 後接原形動詞的規則。

questions.stem: It is still unclear ______ the merger will be finalized by the end of this quarter.

explanation.title: 名詞子句連接詞
explanation.analysis: It is unclear 後接**名詞子句**作真正主詞，表示「是否」合併案會定案，須用 **whether**。(A) what 表示「什麼」不合句意；(C) that 引導事實子句，無法表達「是否」的疑問語氣；(D) who 指人，與句意不合。

questions.stem: The company owns two warehouses; one is in Taipei, and ______ is in Kaohsiung.

explanation.title: 不定代名詞
explanation.analysis: 句中提到「兩個倉庫」（two warehouses），屬於**有範圍**且為**兩者之中剩下的一個**，須用 **the other**。(A) other 應接複數/不可數名詞且無範圍；(B) another 表示「另一個」但無範圍限定；(D) others 為複數形式，與句意（另一個倉庫，單數）不合。

questions.stem: The new marketing strategy proved to be ______ more effective than the previous one.

explanation.title: 比較級的強調用法
explanation.analysis: 修飾比較級形容詞 more effective，須用可修飾比較級的副詞，如 **far**（…得多）。(A) very 只能修飾原級形容詞；(B) many 修飾可數名詞複數；(D) most 為最高級用法，皆與比較級 more effective 不搭配。

questions.stem: The supervisor asked the technician to ______ the malfunctioning equipment before the next shift begins.

explanation.title: 不定詞（ask + O + to V）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 ask + 受詞 + **to + 原形動詞**。(B) inspection 為名詞；(C) inspecting 為動名詞；(D) inspected 為過去式/過去分詞，皆不符合 to 後須接原形動詞的規則。

questions.stem: The keynote speaker not only impressed the audience ______ also inspired several attendees to launch their own start-ups.

explanation.title: 對等連接詞（not only...but also）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 **not only...but (also)...**，表示「不僅...而且...」，須用 **but** 與 not only 呼應。(B)(C)(D) 皆無法與 not only 搭配構成正確的對等連接詞組合。

questions.stem: The board insists that every department head ______ a monthly performance report.

explanation.title: 假設語氣（建議動詞的 that 子句）
explanation.analysis: insist 作「堅持要求」解時，為**建議動詞**，其後 that 子句須用**「(should) + 原形動詞」**的假設語氣，故選 submit。(A) submits 為第三人稱單數現在式；(C) submitting 為動名詞；(D) submitted 為過去式，皆不符合建議動詞後 that 子句的原形動詞規則。

questions.stem: The shipment is expected to arrive ______ the next two business days.

explanation.title: 介系詞（期間內）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在（未來）兩個工作天之內」，須用 **within**（在…範圍內）。(A) during 後接特定的一段期間名詞（如 during the meeting），不用於「未來 N 天內」的語境；(C) among 表示「在（三者以上）之中」；(D) since 表示「自從」，皆與句意不合。

questions.stem: ______ received positive feedback from focus groups, the marketing team decided to launch the campaign nationwide.

explanation.title: 分詞構句（完成式主動分詞）
explanation.analysis: 句首分詞構句的動作（收到正面回饋）發生在主要子句動作（決定全國上市）**之前**，且與主詞 the marketing team 為**主動關係**（行銷團隊主動收到回饋），須用**完成式主動分詞** Having received。(B) Have 為原形動詞；(C) To have 為不定詞；(D) Had 為過去完成式的助動詞形式但不能單獨置於句首作分詞構句，皆不符合此處需求。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：供應商通知信
sections.passage:

We are writing to inform you of a temporary change in our ______ (16) schedule due to the upcoming holiday period. Our warehouse will be closed from December 24 to January 2, and all shipments during this period will be delayed accordingly.

Orders placed before December 20 will be processed and shipped as usual. ______ (17), orders placed after this date will not be fulfilled until our warehouse reopens on January 3.

**(18)** ______

We recommend that you place any urgent orders as early as possible to avoid delays. If you have questions regarding your existing orders, please contact our logistics team ______ (19) the email address below.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 詞性（名詞修飾名詞）
explanation.analysis: schedule 前需要一個**名詞**作複合名詞修飾語，構成 delivery schedule（出貨時程表），故選 delivery。(A) deliver 為動詞；(C) delivered 為過去分詞；(D) delivering 為現在分詞，皆不符合此處複合名詞的固定用法。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 轉折語意連接副詞
explanation.analysis: 前句說「12/20 前下單將如常出貨」，後句說「之後下單則會延遲」，前後語意為**轉折**，須用 **However**（然而）。(A) For example 表舉例；(B) In addition 表附加；(D) Similarly 表相似，皆不符合此處的轉折語意。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: Our company was established more than fifteen years ago.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
The new product line will be available starting next spring.
Please find attached our latest product catalog.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文說明因假期倉庫關閉導致出貨延遲，接續句子應與**致歉**相關，承接對客戶造成不便的情境，故選 (B)「對此造成的不便我們深感抱歉」。(A) 談公司成立時間，離題；(C) 談新產品線上市，離題；(D) 談附上產品型錄，與出貨延遲通知的語境不符。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（透過方式）
explanation.analysis:
表示「透過（下方的電子郵件地址）聯絡」，固定搭配使用 **at**（contact us at + 聯絡方式）。(B) by 較常用於 by phone/by email 等方式名詞前，而非直接接 email address；(C) in 與 (D) on 皆不符合此固定搭配。

### 短文二：公司內部備忘錄

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：公司內部備忘錄
sections.passage:
To: All Department Managers
From: Human Resources
Subject: Updated Performance Review Process

Starting next month, the company will implement a revised performance review process for ______ (20) employee. Each manager will be required to submit evaluation forms electronically rather than on paper.

The new system ______ (21) designed to streamline the review process and reduce paperwork across all departments.

**(22)** ______

All managers must complete a brief training session on the new system before the first review cycle begins. Training sessions will be held ______ (23) the human resources office next Tuesday and Wednesday.

Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Human Resources Department

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 形容詞（修飾單數名詞）
explanation.analysis: for 後接單數名詞 employee，須用可修飾**單數可數名詞**的 **every**（每一個）。(B) all 通常搭配複數名詞（all employees）；(C) most 也搭配複數或不可數名詞；(D) all of 用法不完整（all of + the + 複數名詞），皆與後方單數名詞 employee 不合。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 主詞動詞一致性
explanation.analysis: 主詞 the new system 為單數第三人稱，且句意描述現在的狀態（新制度旨在…），須用**現在式** is。(A) has 為現在完成式助動詞但與 designed 搭配需為 has been designed 才合語法；(C) was 為過去式，與句子描述現行制度的語境不合；(D) had 同樣不符合現在式的需求。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The company's annual revenue grew by ten percent last year.
This change is part of a broader effort to modernize internal operations.
Employees are encouraged to take advantage of the wellness program.
The office will be relocated to a new building next year.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 介系詞（地點）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在人資辦公室（這個場所內）」，須用 **in**。(A) at 通常用於較精確的地點或機構名稱前（如 at the office），但此處後接 the human resources office 且強調「在辦公室內部」舉行訓練，in 更符合此語境的空間概念；(C) on 用於接觸面或特定日期；(D) with 表示「與…一起」，皆不符合地點介系詞的用法。

questions.stem: What is suggested about the welcome dinner on September 10?

sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: The IT support team must resolve all critical tickets ______ the end of business hours.

explanation.title: 介系詞（時間期限）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在（期限）之前」完成動作，須用 **by**，強調截止時間點。(A) at 用於精確時刻，不表示期限；(C) since 表示「自從」，須搭配完成式；(D) among 表示「在三者以上之中」，與時間無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 介系詞 by 表示動作完成的期限，常與 must、have to 等義務句搭配。
explanation.similarNote: 與「submit the quarterly budget report ______ Friday afternoon」同一考點，注意 by 與 until 的差異：by 強調「期限內完成」，until 強調「持續到某時間點」。

questions.stem: By the time the technician arrived, the server ______ malfunctioned twice.

explanation.title: 時態（過去完成式）
explanation.analysis: By the time 引導的子句（the technician arrived）為過去時間點，句意為「技師抵達之前，伺服器已經當機兩次」，須用**過去完成式** had + p.p.。(A)(C) 為現在式/現在完成式，與 by the time + 過去式子句不搭配；(D) was 為 be 動詞過去式，不能直接接過去分詞構成完成式。
explanation.grammarPoint: by the time + S + 過去式，主要子句須用過去完成式，表示「過去的過去」。
explanation.similarNote: 與「By the time the CEO arrives...the staff ______ the entire conference room」結構相反（未來完成式 vs 過去完成式），作答時務必先判斷 by the time 子句的時態是現在式還是過去式。

questions.stem: The new inventory management system, ______ was installed last month, has significantly reduced order errors.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞（非限定用法）
explanation.analysis: 空格前有逗號，引導**非限定關係子句**，先行詞為 the new inventory management system（物），須用 **which**。(A) that 不可用於非限定用法；(B) who 只能指人；(D) what 本身已包含先行詞，不可再接先行詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 逗號 + which 用於補充說明先行詞，去掉該子句句意仍完整。
explanation.similarNote: 同類型考點見「The new employee handbook, ______ was distributed last Monday」，皆為物做先行詞、逗號後接 which。

questions.stem: The new tracking feature allows customers to monitor their shipments ______.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾動詞片語 monitor their shipments，須用**副詞** accurately。(A) accurate 為形容詞；(B) accuracy 為名詞；(D) accuracies 為名詞複數，皆不能修飾動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 動詞 + 副詞的修飾關係，副詞通常置於受詞之後。
explanation.similarNote: 與「track their shipments ______ using the updated mobile application」考點相同，皆考副詞修飾動詞的位置與詞形。

questions.stem: ______ the software update, several users still reported login errors.

explanation.title: 介系詞片語 vs. 連接詞（讓步）
explanation.analysis: 空格後接名詞片語 the software update，須用**介系詞** despite（儘管，後接名詞）。(A) Although 與 (C) Because、(D) Unless 皆為連接詞，須接「主詞+動詞」子句，不可直接接名詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: despite / in spite of + 名詞（片語）；although / though / even though + 子句。
explanation.similarNote: 與「______ the sudden increase in raw material costs」同一考點，皆測驗介系詞與連接詞的接續對象差異。

questions.stem: The shipment, ______ ahead of schedule, arrived at the distribution center on Tuesday.

explanation.title: 分詞（過去分詞作形容詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格與逗號間為插入的分詞片語，修飾主詞 the shipment。貨物與「派送」之間為**被動關係**（貨物被派送出去），須用**過去分詞** dispatched。(A) dispatch 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(B) dispatching 為現在分詞，表主動，語意不合；(D) to dispatch 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞構句用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 名詞 + 過去分詞片語（省略關代與 be 動詞的被動語態子句）。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The contract, ______ by both parties last week」考點相同，皆為被動意涵的過去分詞修飾。

questions.stem: All warehouse staff are required ______ safety goggles while operating the machinery.

explanation.title: 不定詞（be required to V）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 be required **to + 原形動詞**，表示「被要求做某事」。(A) wear 前缺 to，不可直接接在 required 後；(B) wearing 為動名詞；(D) wore 為過去式，皆不符合此固定用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: be required to V、be asked to V、be expected to V 皆為常見的「被要求／被期望」句型。
explanation.similarNote: 與「All interns who wish to ______ the training program」皆考不定詞的固定搭配，但本題為被動語態 be required to，需特別留意 to 前是否已出現。

questions.stem: The IT manager has not yet decided ______ to migrate the database this weekend or next.

explanation.title: 名詞子句連接詞（whether）
explanation.analysis: decide 後接**名詞子句**作受詞，表示「是否」要在本週或下週遷移資料庫，須用 **whether...or...**。(A) what 表示「什麼」，句意不合；(C) that 引導的子句表示「事實」，無法表達「是否」的疑問語氣；(D) if not 文法及語意皆不通順。
explanation.grammarPoint: whether...or... 表示兩者擇一的疑問名詞子句，可作及物動詞的受詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The committee has not yet decided ______ to postpone the annual conference」考點相同，皆為 decide + whether 的固定搭配。

questions.stem: The company operates two data centers; one is located in Taipei, and ______ is in Tainan.

explanation.title: 不定代名詞（the other）
explanation.analysis: 句中提到「兩個資料中心」（two data centers），屬於**有範圍**且為**兩者之中剩下的一個**，須用 **the other**。(A) other 須接複數或不可數名詞；(B) another 表示「另一個」但無範圍限定；(D) others 為複數形式，與句子單數語境不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: one...the other... 表示「兩者中的一個…另一個」。
explanation.similarNote: 與「one is in Taipei, and ______ is in Kaohsiung」考點完全相同，皆為 one...the other 的固定句型。

questions.stem: The new server configuration performs ______ faster than the previous one.

explanation.title: 比較級的強調用法（far）
explanation.analysis: 修飾比較級形容詞/副詞 faster，須用可修飾比較級的副詞 **far**（…得多）。(A) very 只能修飾原級；(B) many 修飾可數名詞複數；(D) most 為最高級用法，與比較級 faster 不搭配。
explanation.grammarPoint: much / far / a lot / even + 比較級，用於加強比較級語氣。
explanation.similarNote: 與「This year's profits were ______ higher than last year's」及「proved to be ______ more effective」為同一考點，須熟記可修飾比較級的副詞群組。

questions.stem: The supervisor asked the warehouse staff ______ the inventory count before the shipment left.

explanation.title: 不定詞（ask + O + to V）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 ask + 受詞 + **to + 原形動詞**，表示「要求某人做某事」。(A) verify 前缺 to；(B) verifying 為動名詞；(D) verified 為過去式，皆不符合此文法規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: ask / tell / require / allow + O + to V，為常見的「五大句型」不定詞用法。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The manager asked her assistant to ______ the meeting minutes」及「The supervisor asked the technician to ______ the malfunctioning equipment」考點完全相同。

questions.stem: The procurement director focused on ______ all vendor contracts before renewing the annual agreement.

explanation.title: 動名詞（介系詞 + V-ing）
explanation.analysis: focus on 為固定片語動詞，其中 on 為介系詞，介系詞後須接**動名詞**，故選 reviewing。(A) review 為原形動詞；(C) to review 為不定詞；(D) reviewed 為過去式，皆不能直接接在介系詞 on 之後。
explanation.grammarPoint: 介系詞 + V-ing 是固定文法規則，focus on、insist on、succeed in 等片語動詞皆適用。
explanation.similarNote: 此為介系詞後接動名詞的考點，與 wish to / decide to 等「動詞 + 不定詞」的考點（如題目 7、11）須加以區別，避免混淆。

questions.stem: The IT department recommended that all employees ______ their passwords every three months.

explanation.title: 假設語氣（建議動詞的 that 子句）
explanation.analysis: recommend 為**建議動詞**，其後 that 子句須用**「(should) + 原形動詞」**的假設語氣，故選 update。(B) updates 為第三人稱單數現在式；(C) updating 為動名詞；(D) updated 為過去式，皆不符合建議動詞後 that 子句的原形動詞規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: suggest / recommend / insist / require + that + S + (should) + 原形動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The consultant recommended that the firm ______ its outdated software immediately」及「The board insists that every department head ______ a monthly performance report」考點完全相同。

questions.stem: The fulfillment center must process all online orders ______ 24 hours of receipt.

explanation.title: 介系詞（期限範圍）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在（時間範圍）之內」須用 **within**。(A) during 表示「在…期間」，後接特定時段名詞（如 during the holiday），不強調期限；(C) among 表示「在三者以上之中」；(D) since 表示「自從」，皆與「24 小時內」的期限語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: within + 一段時間，表示「在…範圍內」，常用於期限、距離的描述。
explanation.similarNote: 與「The shipment is expected to arrive ______ the next two business days」考點相同，皆測驗 within 表示時間範圍的用法。

questions.stem: ______ reviewed the shipping delays, the operations director implemented a new routing system.

explanation.title: 分詞構句（完成式分詞構句）
explanation.analysis: 句首分詞構句表示「審視完貨運延誤情況」這個動作發生在主要子句動作**之前**，且與主詞 the operations director 為主動關係，須用**現在完成式分詞** Having + p.p.。(A) Have 為原形助動詞，不可單獨置於句首作分詞構句；(C) To have 為不定詞；(D) Had 為過去式，皆不符合分詞構句的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: Having + p.p., S + V... 表示「先做完某動作之後」的完成式分詞構句。
explanation.similarNote: 與「Having reviewed all the applications, the HR director ______ three candidates」及「______ received positive feedback from focus groups, the marketing team decided to launch the campaign」考點相同。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：IT 部門系統維護公告
sections.passage:
To: All Staff
From: IT Department
Subject: Scheduled System Maintenance

Please be advised that our internal software system will undergo scheduled maintenance beginning this Friday at 6:00 p.m. During the maintenance window, any orders ______ (16) through the online portal will not be processed until the system resumes.

The upgrade is expected to take approximately six hours to complete. ______ (17), technicians may need additional time if unexpected complications arise during installation.

**(18)** ______

All employees should save their work and log out of the system before 5:45 p.m. on Friday. IT will not be able to recover any unsaved data lost during the shutdown. Should you encounter any errors once the system is back online, please reach out to the helpdesk ______ (19) extension 312.

Thank you for your patience as we work to improve system performance.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 分詞作形容詞片語（被動）
explanation.analysis: any orders ______ through the online portal 為省略關代與 be 動詞的形容詞子句（= that are placed through the online portal），修飾 orders，須用**過去分詞** placed 表示被動意涵（訂單「被下」）。(A) place 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(B) placing 為現在分詞，表主動，語意不合（訂單不會主動下單）；(D) to place 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞修飾的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 名詞 + 過去分詞片語，用於修飾承受動作的名詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一「staff members currently ______ on the third floor」考點相同（分詞修飾名詞），但本題為被動語意（placed），該題為主動語意（working），須依語意判斷分詞的主動/被動。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 轉折語意連接副詞
explanation.analysis: 前句說「預計六小時完成」，後句說「若有突發狀況可能需要更多時間」，前後語意為**轉折**，須用 **However**（然而）。(A) Therefore 表示「因此」為因果關係；(C) In addition 表示「此外」為附加關係；(D) For example 表示「例如」為舉例關係，皆不符合此處的轉折語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: However / Nevertheless 表轉折；Therefore / As a result 表因果；In addition / Moreover 表附加。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 17 考點完全相同，皆為「預期完成時間」後接轉折語意的連接副詞。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The new office furniture has already been ordered from the supplier.
All employees are required to attend the annual safety training session.
A temporary backup system will remain available for urgent customer inquiries.
The company's quarterly earnings exceeded analysts' expectations.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文談的是系統維護期間資料無法存取、需儲存工作等安排，接續的句子應與**維護期間的替代措施**相關，故選 (C)「臨時備援系統將維持運作以處理緊急客戶詢問」，承接上文的系統中斷主題。(A) 談新辦公家具已訂購，與系統維護無關；(B) 談安全訓練課程，離題；(D) 談公司季度盈餘，與本文全無關聯。
explanation.grammarPoint: Part 6 選句題須依上下文的**主題連貫性**（cohesion）判斷，答案句需承接前後句的邏輯關係。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一、二的插入句題型相同，作答時應先排除與全文主題無關的選項，再確認邏輯銜接是否通順。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（聯絡方式）
explanation.analysis: 表示「聯絡…分機號碼」，固定搭配為 contact/reach out to + 對象 + **at** + extension（分機號碼），故選 at。(B) in 與 (D) with 不能與 extension 構成此固定搭配；(C) by 通常用於「透過某種方式/工具」，不用於直接接續分機號碼。
explanation.grammarPoint: at + extension（分機）為固定搭配，與 by phone、by email 等「透過方式」的 by 不同。
explanation.similarNote:
與模擬測驗一題目 19「contact the facilities office ______ extension 245」考點完全相同。

### 短文二：貨運延誤通知信

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：貨運延誤通知信
sections.passage:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Thank you for ______ (20) recent order with GlobalFreight Logistics. We are writing to inform you that your shipment has been delayed due to a customs inspection at the port of entry.

Our tracking system indicates that your package ______ (21) currently held for routine clearance and should be released within two business days.

**(22)** ______

We understand that this delay may affect your planned schedule, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience it may cause. If you would like to receive updates by text message instead of email, please let us know ______ (23) advance.

Thank you for your patience and continued business with us.

Sincerely,
Customer Support Team
GlobalFreight Logistics

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 所有格代名詞（形容詞性）
explanation.analysis: 空格後接名詞 order，須用**所有格**修飾名詞，故選 your。(A) you 為受格/主格；(C) yours 為所有格代名詞（等於 your + 名詞，後面不可再接名詞）；(D) yourself 為反身代名詞，皆不符合空格後須接名詞的文法結構。
explanation.grammarPoint: 所有格形容詞（my/your/his...）須直接接名詞，所有格代名詞（mine/yours/his...）則不可再接名詞。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 20「Thank you for ______ interest in our upcoming leadership workshop」考點完全相同。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 時態與語態（現在簡單式被動）
explanation.analysis: package 與 hold（扣留）之間為**被動關係**（包裹「被」扣留），且描述目前的狀態，須用**現在簡單式被動語態** is held。(A) hold 為原形動詞，主動語態且與單數主詞不一致；(B) holds 為主動語態的現在式，語意錯誤（包裹不會主動扣留東西）；(D) held 缺少 be 動詞，無法單獨構成完整的被動語態。
explanation.grammarPoint: 現在簡單式被動語態：S + is/am/are + p.p.，描述目前存在的狀態。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 21（workshop begins，主動現在式）不同，本題須先判斷主詞與動詞之間是主動還是被動關係，再決定是否需要 be 動詞。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: Please note that parking is available in the lot adjacent to the building.
Once released, the shipment will be forwarded directly to the address on file.
Our marketing team recently launched a new advertising campaign.
The workshop was postponed due to unforeseen circumstances.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文提到包裹目前因海關檢查被扣留，預計兩個工作天內放行，接續句子應與**放行後的後續安排**銜接，故選 (B)「一旦放行，貨物將直接轉送至登記地址」，屬於物流通知的合理延伸。(A) 談停車場位置，離題；(C) 談行銷團隊活動，離題；(D) 談工作坊延期，與本文語意無關（本文是貨運延誤通知，非工作坊通知）。
explanation.grammarPoint: Part 6 選句題須確認代名詞或情境是否與上下文一致（如 released 呼應前句的 held）。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一、二的插入句題型相同，需注意選項中出現的名詞是否與全文情境（貨運、客服）相符。

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 介系詞（固定搭配 in advance）
explanation.analysis: **in advance**（提前）為固定片語，故選 in。(A) at、(B) on、(D) for 皆不能與 advance 構成此固定搭配。
explanation.grammarPoint: in advance（提前）為不可拆解的介系詞固定搭配。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 23「three business days ______ advance」考點完全相同。

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章一：自動化倉儲系統上線公告
sections.passage:
**Notice: Automated Warehousing System Now Live**

Meridian Logistics is pleased to announce that its new automated warehousing system, WareBot, has been fully activated at our central distribution center as of this week. The system uses robotic sorting arms and real-time inventory scanners to process incoming and outgoing shipments with greater speed and accuracy.

Since going live, WareBot has reduced average order processing time by nearly 40 percent and virtually eliminated manual sorting errors. The system also generates automatic alerts whenever stock levels for any item fall below the reorder threshold, allowing the procurement team to place replenishment orders before shortages occur.

All warehouse staff will receive hands-on training on operating alongside WareBot during the next two weeks. Employees who previously handled manual sorting duties will be reassigned to oversee quality control and system monitoring. No layoffs are planned as part of this transition.

For questions about the new system or the upcoming training schedule, please contact the operations office at ext. 208.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?

options.text: To announce a merger with another logistics company
To introduce a new automated system in the warehouse
To advertise a job opening in operations
To report a decline in shipment accuracy

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭即說明 Meridian Logistics is pleased to announce that its new automated warehousing system, WareBot, has been fully activated，全文圍繞新系統的功能與影響展開，故答案為 (B)「介紹倉儲中新導入的自動化系統」。(A) 公司合併、(C) 職缺廣告、(D) 出貨準確率下降皆未在文中提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題須看文章第一段（通常是開頭一到兩句）掌握全文核心目的。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗二題目 24「What is being announced in this notice?」同為主旨題，答題技巧相同：鎖定首段的宣布性句子。

questions.stem: According to the notice, when does the system generate an automatic alert?

options.text: When a shipment is delayed at customs
When stock levels fall below the reorder threshold
When an employee logs into the system
When a customer submits a complaint

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 the system also generates automatic alerts whenever stock levels for any item fall below the reorder threshold，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須以題目關鍵字（automatic alert）回文章中定位對應句子。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 29「what will customers need to do when logging in from a new device」同為定位型細節題。

questions.stem: What will happen to employees who previously handled manual sorting duties?

options.text: They will be transferred to a different distribution center.
They will be reassigned to oversee quality control and system monitoring.
They will be laid off within two weeks.
They will receive a pay reduction.

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 Employees who previously handled manual sorting duties will be reassigned to oversee quality control and system monitoring，故答案為 (B)。(A) 轉調其他配送中心、(C) 兩週內遭資遣、(D) 減薪，文中皆未提及，且文末明確說明 No layoffs are planned，與 (C) 矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題常設有「明確與原文矛盾」的誘答選項（如本題的 (C)），需特別留意文章中的否定敘述。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 30「What are customers advised to do before the change takes effect?」同為需要精確比對原文的細節題。

questions.stem: The word "threshold" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "threshold" 於此語境指「（存貨量的）門檻／臨界值」，即「最低可接受的水準」，故最接近 (B) minimum acceptable level。(A) surplus（過剩）恰好相反；(C) sales target（銷售目標）與存貨水準無關；(D) shipping fee（運費）與原意無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 字義題須依上下文語境判斷字詞的實際意涵，而非僅依字面直譯。
explanation.similarNote:
與模擬測驗一題目 27「shortlisted」、題目 31「compromised」同為字義題，皆須依段落語境選出最接近的同義詞。

### 文章二：供應商貨運時程調整通知信

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章二：供應商貨運時程調整通知信
sections.passage:
Dear Valued Supplier,

We are writing to inform you of an upcoming change to our receiving schedule at the Chiayi Distribution Center. Beginning next month, all incoming deliveries must be scheduled through our new online booking portal at least 48 hours in advance. Deliveries arriving without a confirmed appointment may be turned away or subject to significant delays.

This change is part of our effort to reduce dock congestion and improve turnaround times for both inbound and outbound shipments. Once you submit a delivery request through the portal, you will receive a confirmation email with an assigned loading dock number and estimated unloading time.

Please note that the receiving dock will no longer accept deliveries between 12:00 p.m. and 1:00 p.m. due to staff shift changes. Suppliers who repeatedly fail to comply with the new scheduling requirements may be subject to a review of their vendor agreement.

If you have any questions about the new booking system or need assistance registering for portal access, please contact our vendor relations team at vendors@meridianlogistics.com.

Thank you for your cooperation as we work to streamline our receiving operations.

Sincerely,
Vendor Relations Team
Meridian Logistics

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this letter?

options.text: To announce a new partnership with a supplier
To notify suppliers of a new delivery scheduling requirement
To apologize for a shipment delay
To advertise a new warehouse location

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭說明 We are writing to inform you of an upcoming change to our receiving schedule...all incoming deliveries must be scheduled through our new online booking portal，故答案為 (B)「通知供應商新的送貨排程規定」。(A) 新夥伴關係、(C) 貨運延誤致歉、(D) 新倉儲地點廣告皆與文章主旨不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題須留意信件開頭 We are writing to... 這類慣用開場句，通常直接點明全文目的。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 28「Why did SecureBank send this letter?」考點相同，皆為通知類信件的主旨判斷。

questions.stem: What may happen to a delivery that arrives without a confirmed appointment?

options.text: It may be turned away or delayed.
It will be charged an additional fee automatically.
It will be redirected to a partner facility.

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 Deliveries arriving without a confirmed appointment may be turned away or subject to significant delays，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須留意 may / could 等表示「可能性」的助動詞，避免將「可能發生」誤判為「必然發生」。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗二題目 30「What should employees do if they plan to drive themselves to the retreat?」同為條件式細節題。

questions.stem: What will suppliers receive after submitting a request through the booking portal?

options.text: A confirmation email with a dock number and estimated time

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 you will receive a confirmation email with an assigned loading dock number and estimated unloading time，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題答案通常會將原文詞語（confirmation email, dock number, estimated time）以同義改寫或原詞呈現於選項中。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 26「what should interested applicants do」同為需要在文中精確定位動作結果的細節題。

questions.stem: The word "streamline" in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "streamline" 於此語境指「使（流程）更有效率、更順暢」，最接近 (B) make more efficient。(A) complicate（使複雜化）恰好相反；(C) expand significantly（大幅擴張）與原意無關；(D) postpone indefinitely（無限期延後）與原意無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: streamline 為商業英文常見動詞，常與 process、operation、procedure 等名詞搭配，表示「精簡化、提升效率」。
explanation.similarNote: 與模擬測驗一題目 27、題目 31 及本回題目 27 同為字義題，作答時須排除「字面相似但語意相反或無關」的選項。

sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: The overseas subsidiary must submit its quarterly financial statement ______ the fifth business day of each month.

explanation.title: 介系詞（期限）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在（期限）之前」須用 **by**，強調動作須在該時間點之前完成。(A) at 用於精確時間點，不表示期限；(C) among 用於三者以上之中；(D) since 表示「自從」，須搭配完成式，與句意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: by／before／until 等時間介系詞的區別：by 強調期限，before 強調先後順序，until 強調動作持續到某時間點為止。
explanation.similarNote: 凡句中出現「必須在某期限前完成」的語意，優先考慮 by 或 before；若空格後接完整子句而非時間點名詞，則應改選連接詞 before。

questions.stem: Before headquarters approved the final figures, the overseas office ______ its budget forecast three times in response to currency fluctuations.

explanation.title: 時態（過去完成式）
explanation.analysis: 句首 Before headquarters approved the final figures 為過去時間子句，表示「總部核准最終數字」這個過去動作發生之前，海外辦公室已經修改過三次預算，須用**過去完成式** had revised 表達「過去的過去」。(A) revises 為現在式；(B) revised 為簡單過去式，無法表達「在某過去時間點之前已完成」的先後關係；(C) has revised 為現在完成式，應搭配現在的時間點。
explanation.grammarPoint: 過去完成式（had + p.p.）用於描述兩個過去事件中，較早發生的那一個，常與 before／after／by the time 等時間子句連用。
explanation.similarNote: 只要句中出現「before/by the time + 過去式子句」，且空格所在的主要子句動作發生得更早，就應選過去完成式。

questions.stem: The joint venture agreement, ______ was signed by executives from both countries last week, includes a clause on profit sharing.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞
explanation.analysis: 空格前有逗號，引導**非限定用法的關係子句**，先行詞為 the joint venture agreement（物），須用 **which**。(A) that 不可用於非限定用法；(B) what 本身已包含先行詞，不可再接先行詞；(D) who 只能指人。
explanation.grammarPoint: 非限定用法（有逗號）的關係子句中，先行詞為物時用 which，為人時用 who，且一律不可用 that。
explanation.similarNote: 判斷關係代名詞時，先看空格前後是否有逗號：有逗號即為非限定用法，that 一律排除。

questions.stem: The negotiation team communicated the revised trade terms ______ to avoid any misunderstanding with the overseas partner.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾動詞 communicated，表示「清楚地傳達」，須用**副詞** clearly。(A) clear 為形容詞；(B) clearer 為形容詞比較級；(D) cleared 為動詞過去式/過去分詞，皆不符合修飾動詞的文法角色。
explanation.grammarPoint: 副詞用來修飾動詞、形容詞或另一個副詞，一般字尾為 -ly；判斷空格是否修飾動詞是選擇副詞的關鍵線索。
explanation.similarNote: 凡空格緊接在及物動詞的受詞之後，且用來說明「動作進行的方式」，即應選副詞。

questions.stem: ______ the unfavorable exchange rate this quarter, the subsidiary still met its revenue target.

explanation.title: 介系詞片語 vs. 連接詞
explanation.analysis: 空格後接的是名詞片語（the unfavorable exchange rate），須用**介系詞** despite（儘管，後接名詞）。(A) Although 與 (C) Because 及 (D) Unless 皆為連接詞，須接「主詞+動詞」的完整子句，不可直接接名詞片語。
explanation.grammarPoint: despite／in spite of 為介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞；although／even though／because 為連接詞，後接完整子句。
explanation.similarNote: 先看空格後方是名詞片語還是完整子句，是判斷介系詞或連接詞最快的方法，不需先讀懂全句語意。

questions.stem: The revised tariff schedule, ______ by the trade ministry last month, applies to all imported machinery parts.

explanation.title: 分詞（過去分詞作形容詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格與逗號間為插入的分詞片語，修飾主詞 the revised tariff schedule。關稅表與「發布」之間為**被動關係**（關稅表被貿易部發布），須用**過去分詞** issued。(A) issue 為原形動詞，不可單獨作修飾語；(B) issuing 為現在分詞，表示主動，語意不合（關稅表不會主動發布）；(D) to issue 為不定詞，不符合此處分詞構句的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 分詞修飾名詞時，名詞與分詞為主動關係用現在分詞，為被動關係用過去分詞；文件類名詞（合約、關稅表、報告）多為被動，常搭配過去分詞。
explanation.similarNote: 凡「文件, ______ by + 執行者，...」的句型，空格幾乎必為過去分詞，因文件本身無法主動執行動作。

questions.stem: Foreign investors who wish to ______ in the new manufacturing plant must submit a formal proposal to the board.

explanation.title: 不定詞
explanation.analysis: wish to + **原形動詞**為固定用法，表示「希望做某事」。(B) investing 為動名詞，不可接在 to 後面；(C) invested 為過去式；(D) invests 為第三人稱單數現在式，皆不符合 to 後接原形動詞的規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: wish／hope／want／plan 等動詞後接不定詞 to V，表達尚未發生的意圖或期望。
explanation.similarNote: 只要看到 wish to／hope to／plan to 後方留空，直接選原形動詞，不須考慮時態。

questions.stem: The finance committee has not yet decided ______ to allocate additional funds to the overseas branch this fiscal year.

explanation.title: 名詞子句連接詞
explanation.analysis: decide 後接**名詞子句**作受詞，表示「是否」要撥款給海外分公司，須用 **whether**（是否）。(A) what 表示「什麼」，句意不合；(C) that 引導的名詞子句表示「事實」，不能表達「是否」的疑問語氣；(D) if not 文法及語意皆不通順。
explanation.grammarPoint: whether 可引導名詞子句表示「是否」，常接在 decide／determine／unclear／uncertain 等動詞或形容詞之後。
explanation.similarNote: 凡句意為「尚未決定/不確定是否…」，優先考慮 whether；若後面出現 or not，更能確認為 whether 而非 if。

questions.stem: Of the two funding options presented at the meeting, the CFO prefers ______ that offers a lower interest rate.

explanation.title: 不定代名詞
explanation.analysis: 句中提到「兩個資金方案」（the two funding options），屬於**有範圍**且為**兩者之中剩下的一個**，須用 **the other**。(A) other 後應接複數名詞或不可數名詞；(B) another 表示「另一個」但無範圍限定；(D) others 為複數形式，與句子單數語境不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: two...one is..., the other is... 為固定句型，表示兩者中「另一個」，範圍固定為二。
explanation.similarNote: 只要句首出現「of the two...」，空格代名詞幾乎必為 the other，而非 another 或 others。

questions.stem: This quarter's export revenue was ______ higher than the figure projected in the annual budget.

explanation.title: 比較級的強調用法
explanation.analysis: 修飾比較級形容詞 higher，須用可修飾比較級的副詞，如 **much**（…得多）。(B) very 只能修飾原級形容詞；(C) many 用於修飾可數名詞複數；(D) most 為最高級用法，與句中的比較級 higher 不搭配。
explanation.grammarPoint: much／far／even／a lot 等可加強比較級語氣；very／so／too 只能修飾原級形容詞或副詞。
explanation.similarNote: 只要空格緊接在「比較級形容詞/副詞」之前，優先考慮 much 或 far，而非 very。

questions.stem: The regional manager asked the accountant to ______ the currency conversion rates before finalizing the shipping report.

explanation.title: 不定詞（ask + O + to V）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 ask + 受詞 + **to + 原形動詞**，表示「要求某人做某事」。(B) verification 為名詞；(C) verifying 為動名詞；(D) verified 為過去式/過去分詞，皆不符合 to 後須接原形動詞的規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: ask／tell／want／require + 受詞 + to V 為常見的「使役型」句構，to 後一律接原形動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 看到 ask/tell/require + 人 + to ______，直接選原形動詞。

questions.stem: Not only did the subsidiary lower its production costs, ______ it also increased its export volume to Southeast Asia.

explanation.title: 對等連接詞（not only...but also）
explanation.analysis: 固定句型 **not only...but (also)...**，表示「不僅...而且...」，此句用了倒裝（Not only did the subsidiary...），後半句須搭配 **but** 呼應。(B)(C)(D) 皆無法與 not only 搭配構成正確的對等連接詞組合。
explanation.grammarPoint: not only 置於句首時，其所在子句須採**倒裝**（助動詞提前），後半句固定搭配 but (also)。
explanation.similarNote: 凡看到 Not only + 助動詞 + 主詞... 開頭的倒裝句，空格幾乎必為 but。

questions.stem: The auditor recommended that the overseas branch ______ its expense records more frequently to prevent reporting delays.

explanation.title: 假設語氣（建議動詞的 that 子句）
explanation.analysis: recommend 為**建議動詞**，其後 that 子句須用**「(should) + 原形動詞」**的假設語氣，故選 update。(A) updates 為第三人稱單數現在式；(C) updating 為動名詞；(D) updated 為過去式，皆不符合建議動詞後 that 子句的原形動詞規則。
explanation.grammarPoint: recommend／suggest／insist／require／demand 等建議、要求類動詞，其後 that 子句一律用原形動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 只要主詞句動詞屬於「建議/要求」類，that 子句空格直接選原形動詞，不受主詞單複數或時態影響。

questions.stem: All international wire transfers exceeding the daily limit must be approved ______ the end of the business day.

explanation.title: 介系詞（期限）
explanation.analysis: 表示「在…之前」須用 **before**。(A) during 表示「在…期間」；(B) between 表示「在兩者之間」；(D) among 表示「在（三者以上）之中」，皆與「當日結束之前」的期限語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: before 可作介系詞（後接名詞）或連接詞（後接子句），皆表示「在…之前」。
explanation.similarNote: 凡語意為「在某時間點之前完成」，且空格後為名詞（非完整子句），before 與 by 皆為常見答案，須依句意細節（期限 vs. 順序）判斷。

questions.stem: Having reviewed the trade partner's latest financial statements, the board ______ to proceed with the joint venture.

explanation.title: 主要子句動詞時態（搭配句首分詞構句）
explanation.analysis: 句首 Having reviewed the trade partner's latest financial statements 為**完成式分詞構句**，表示「審閱財報」這個動作發生在主要子句動作**之前**，且與主詞 the board 為主動關係（董事會主動審閱）。空格位於主要子句，須為**主要動詞**，且應與分詞構句所暗示的過去時間點一致，故用**過去式** decided。(A) decide 為原形動詞，不能單獨作主要動詞；(B) decides 為現在式，與過去事件不合；(D) deciding 為現在分詞，不能作主要子句的唯一動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: Having + p.p. 為完成式分詞構句，表示「先發生」的動作；主要子句動詞應與其暗示的時間點一致，常為過去式。
explanation.similarNote: 凡句首為 Having + p.p.,主要子句空格多為簡單過去式，且分詞構句省略的主詞須與主要子句主詞一致。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：公司內部備忘錄
sections.passage:
To: All Department Directors
From: Corporate Finance Office
Subject: Revised Budget Allocation for Overseas Expansion

We are writing to inform all department directors of an important adjustment to this year's budget allocation. Due to the recent partnership agreement with our supplier in Vietnam, additional funds ______ (16) to the international procurement division to cover increased shipping and tariff costs.

This reallocation will reduce the discretionary budget available to domestic departments by approximately eight percent. ______ (17), departments that can demonstrate a direct link between their spending and export growth may apply for supplementary funding.

**(18)** ______

Please submit your revised departmental budget proposals to the finance office no later than the end of this month. If you have any questions regarding the new allocation, please contact the finance office ______ (19) email.

Thank you for your understanding as we adjust to these changes.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 時態與語態（未來被動式）
explanation.analysis: 上下文描述「因為與越南供應商簽訂新合作協議」，接下來（尚未發生）將把資金撥給國際採購部門，且資金是「被撥給」（被動），須用**未來被動式** will be allocated。(A) allocate 為原形動詞，不可單獨作句子的主要動詞；(C) allocating 為現在分詞，不能單獨作主要動詞；(D) allocated 為過去式/過去分詞，與上下文「即將調整」的未來語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 未來被動式 will be + p.p.，表示未來將發生且主詞為承受動作的一方。
explanation.similarNote: 凡描述「尚未執行但已確定將發生」的被動行為，優先考慮 will be + p.p.。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 轉折語意連接副詞
explanation.analysis: 前句說「這次重新分配將使國內部門的自由裁量預算減少約 8%」，後句說「能證明支出與出口成長直接相關的部門可申請補充經費」，前後語意為**轉折**（先講削減，後講例外補償），須用 **However**（然而）。(A) Therefore 表示「因此」為因果關係；(C) In addition 表示「此外」為附加關係；(D) For example 表示「例如」為舉例關係，皆不符合此處的轉折語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: 連接副詞需依前後句的邏輯關係選擇：因果用 therefore/as a result，轉折用 however/nevertheless，附加用 in addition/furthermore。
explanation.similarNote: 判斷連接副詞時，先確認前後兩句是「順接」還是「轉折」關係，再決定選項。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: The finance office will review these applications on a case-by-case basis.
Our company was founded more than twenty years ago.
The annual employee satisfaction survey will be distributed next week.
The new office furniture has already been delivered.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上文提到「能證明支出與出口成長直接相關的部門可申請補充經費」，緊接的句子應說明**申請後的處理方式**，故選 (A)「財務室將依個案審核這些申請」，承接上文的補充經費申請主題。(B) 談公司成立時間，離題；(C) 談員工滿意度調查，離題；(D) 談新辦公家具送達，與本文全無關聯。
explanation.grammarPoint: Part 6 插入句題須確認邏輯銜接對象是「前一句」還是「後一句」，並排除與全文主旨無關的選項。
explanation.similarNote: 遇到插入句題，先讀懂前後兩句的語意銜接點，再逐一排除離題選項，而非只看單句是否語法正確。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（聯絡方式）
explanation.analysis: 表示「透過電子郵件聯絡」，固定搭配為 contact + 對象 + **by** + 方式（by email、by phone），故選 by。(A) at 與 (B) in 不能與 email 構成此固定搭配；(D) with 通常表示「使用工具」的另一種語意，不用於此處聯絡方式的固定用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: by 可表示「透過某種方式/工具」，如 by email、by phone、by mail 皆為固定搭配。
explanation.similarNote:
凡看到「聯絡…（方式）」的語意，且空格後為溝通媒介（email/phone/mail），優先考慮 by。
