### 短文二：貿易夥伴聯繫信

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：貿易夥伴聯繫信
sections.passage:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

We truly value the ______ (20) collaboration between our two companies over the past three years, and we would like to propose a slight revision to the payment schedule outlined in our current shipment agreement.

Under the revised terms, 30 percent of the total invoice amount ______ (21) upon confirmation of the purchase order, with the remaining balance due within 45 days of delivery.

**(22)** ______

Please note that the shipping cost will now be calculated according to the updated tariff schedule announced by the trade ministry last week. We believe this adjustment reflects current market conditions more accurately ______ (23) the previous flat-rate structure did.

We look forward to your confirmation at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
International Sales Department

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 詞性（形容詞修飾名詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾名詞 collaboration，須用**形容詞** close（緊密的）。(B) closely 為副詞，不可直接修飾名詞；(C) closeness 為名詞，不可修飾另一個名詞；(D) closed 為過去分詞/形容詞，但語意為「已關閉的」，與「緊密的合作」語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 形容詞置於名詞之前修飾該名詞；close 作形容詞時意為「親近的、緊密的」，作副詞（closely）時則修飾動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 空格緊接在冠詞（the）之後、名詞之前，且該名詞前只有一個修飾語空格時，優先考慮形容詞。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 時態與語態（未來被動式）
explanation.analysis: 上下文描述「修訂後的付款條件」中，30% 的發票金額將於採購單確認後**被支付**，屬於**未來且被動**的動作，須用 will be paid。(A) pays 為主動語態現在式；(C) paid 為過去式/過去分詞，不能單獨作主要動詞；(D) is paying 為現在進行式主動語態，皆與句意（金額被支付、且為未來動作）不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 未來被動式 will be + p.p.，常見於描述付款、交貨等尚未發生但已排定的商務流程。
explanation.similarNote: 凡句中主詞是「款項/貨物」等承受動作的對象，且動作尚未發生，多為未來被動式。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: This structure is intended to help both parties manage cash flow more effectively.
Our company was established more than fifteen years ago.
The new product line will be available starting next spring.
Please find attached our latest product catalog.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上文說明新付款條件（30% 訂金、餘額 45 天內付清），緊接的句子應說明**此安排的用意**，故選 (A)「此架構旨在幫助雙方更有效地管理現金流」，承接付款條件的說明。(B) 談公司成立時間，離題；(C) 談新產品線上市時間，離題；(D) 談產品型錄附件，與本文語意無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 插入句應緊扣前一句的主題（此處為付款條件），並說明其目的或效果，才符合上下文邏輯。
explanation.similarNote: 遇到說明新制度/新條款的段落，插入句常見功能是解釋「為什麼這樣安排」，可作為判斷依據。

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 比較句型（than）
explanation.analysis: 句中出現比較級 more accurately，須搭配 **than** 引導比較對象子句（the previous flat-rate structure did）。(A) as 用於同級比較（as...as），與此處比較級不合；(B) that 與 (D) which 皆為關係代名詞，無法引導比較子句。
explanation.grammarPoint: 比較級形容詞/副詞（more/-er）須搭配 than 引導比較對象；同級比較才用 as...as。
explanation.similarNote: 只要句中出現 more + 形容詞/副詞 或 -er 結尾的比較級，空格若須連接比較對象子句，答案幾乎必為 than。

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章一：合資企業新聞稿
sections.passage:
**Global Horizon Manufacturing and Andes Materials Group Announce Joint Venture**

Global Horizon Manufacturing, a leading producer of industrial components, today announced a new joint venture with Andes Materials Group, a raw material supplier based in Chile. The partnership, named the Horizon-Andes Alliance, will focus on securing a stable supply of copper and aluminum for Global Horizon's expanding production lines.

Under the terms of the agreement, Andes Materials Group will supply raw materials at a fixed exchange rate for the first three years, protecting both companies from currency fluctuations. In exchange, Global Horizon Manufacturing will invest in upgrading Andes' processing facilities in Santiago, allowing the supplier to increase output by 25 percent.

Analysts note that the joint venture reflects a broader trend among manufacturers seeking to reduce their exposure to volatile commodity markets through long-term international partnerships. The companies expect the agreement to lower material costs by approximately 12 percent over the next five years.

The joint venture is expected to take effect on October 1, pending final approval from regulatory authorities in both countries. A detailed financial report on the partnership's projected impact will be released to shareholders next quarter.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this press release?

options.text: To report a decline in quarterly earnings
To announce a new international partnership
To introduce a new line of industrial products
To announce the retirement of a company executive

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭即說明 Global Horizon Manufacturing...announced a new joint venture with Andes Materials Group，全文圍繞這項國際合資案的內容與條款展開，故答案為 (B)「宣布一項新的國際合作案」。(A) 季度獲利下滑、(C) 新產品線、(D) 高層退休皆未在文中提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題應鎖定文章第一段的核心動作（宣布、公告、通知），該動作通常即為全文主旨。
explanation.similarNote: Part 7 主旨題多可從首段第一句找到答案，尤其是含 announce／inform／is pleased to 等字眼的句子。

questions.stem: What will Global Horizon Manufacturing provide as part of the agreement?

options.text: A fixed exchange rate for raw materials
Investment to upgrade Andes' processing facilities
A loan to cover Andes' operating expenses
Additional shipping vessels for raw material transport

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 Global Horizon Manufacturing will invest in upgrading Andes' processing facilities in Santiago，故答案為 (B)「投資升級 Andes 的加工設備」。(A) 為 Andes 提供給 Global Horizon 的條件，並非 Global Horizon 提供的；(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須注意句子的「主詞」與「受詞」關係，避免將雙方各自提供的條件互相混淆。
explanation.similarNote: 涉及「雙方協議內容」的細節題，務必分辨題目問的是哪一方提供的條件，而非籠統地找關鍵字。

questions.stem: According to the article, why are the two companies entering this joint venture?

options.text: To comply with a new government regulation
To reduce exposure to volatile commodity markets
To merge into a single corporation
To relocate their headquarters closer together

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 the joint venture reflects a broader trend among manufacturers seeking to reduce their exposure to volatile commodity markets，故答案為 (B)「降低暴露於不穩定原物料市場的風險」。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 原因/目的類細節題常以 in order to／to reduce／aims to 等字眼呈現，注意動詞不定詞片語所表達的目的。
explanation.similarNote: 尋找「為什麼」的答案時，優先鎖定文中表達目的或原因的片語（如 seeking to、in an effort to）。

questions.stem: The word "volatile" in the third paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "volatile" 於原物料市場語境中指「（價格/市場）不穩定、易波動」，故最接近 (B) unstable。(A) profitable（有利可圖的）、(C) regulated（受規範的）、(D) declining（下滑的）皆與原意不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 字義題應代入原句重新閱讀，確認替換字詞後句意是否通順一致。
explanation.similarNote:
"volatile"、"fluctuate" 等字常出現在財務/市場情境，皆與「不穩定、變動」相關，可歸為同一組同義詞群。

### 文章二：貿易條款協商信

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章二：貿易條款協商信
sections.passage:
Dear Mr. Takahashi,

We are writing in response to your letter dated June 3 regarding the recent increase in import tariffs affecting our trade agreement. As you noted, the new tariff rate imposed on textile imports has raised our overall shipping costs by nearly 18 percent, which was not anticipated when we signed the original contract last year.

After reviewing our financial projections, we would like to propose renegotiating the pricing clause of our agreement to reflect these additional costs. Specifically, we suggest adjusting the unit price by 8 percent, with the remaining difference absorbed by our company in order to preserve the long-term stability of our partnership.

We understand that this proposal may affect your budget planning for the coming fiscal year, and we are prepared to discuss alternative arrangements, including a temporary reduction in order volume, if that would better suit your company's needs.

We value the trust we have built over the past six years and are committed to finding a solution that keeps both companies financially sound. Please let us know your thoughts by July 15 so that we can finalize the revised terms before the next shipment is scheduled.

Sincerely,
Trade Relations Department

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this letter?

options.text: To cancel an existing trade agreement
To propose renegotiating the pricing terms of a contract
To announce a new tariff policy
To request payment for an overdue invoice

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章第二段明確提出 we would like to propose renegotiating the pricing clause of our agreement to reflect these additional costs，故答案為 (B)「提議重新協商合約的定價條款」。(A) 取消合約、(C) 宣布新關稅政策、(D) 要求支付逾期款項皆與文章主旨不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 商業書信的主旨常出現在開頭說明背景後的第二段，留意 propose／would like to／we are writing to 等表達意圖的句型。
explanation.similarNote: 主旨題若首段僅為背景說明，須繼續往下讀到「提出訴求」的句子，才是真正的主旨所在。

questions.stem: According to the letter, by how much have shipping costs risen?

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 the new tariff rate...has raised our overall shipping costs by nearly 18 percent，故答案為 (C) 18 percent。(A) 8 percent 為建議調整的單價漲幅，(B) 12 percent 與 (D) 25 percent 皆未於本文中出現對應數字。
explanation.grammarPoint: 數字類細節題須特別留意文中出現的多個百分比分別對應的項目（漲幅、調整幅度、產能提升等），避免張冠李戴。
explanation.similarNote: 文章中出現多個百分比數字時，逐一標註其對應的名詞（成本上升／單價調整／產能提升），才能準確作答。

questions.stem: What alternative arrangement does the sender offer to consider?

options.text: Switching to a different shipping carrier
Cancelling the remaining shipments for the year
A temporary reduction in order volume
Paying the full tariff increase themselves

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 we are prepared to discuss alternative arrangements, including a temporary reduction in order volume，故答案為 (C)「暫時減少訂購量」。(A)(B)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題常見「including + 名詞」片語點出具體選項，可作為快速定位答案的線索。
explanation.similarNote: 看到 including／such as 等舉例片語時，其後內容往往就是細節題的答案來源。

questions.stem: The word "absorbed" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: "absorbed" 於財務語境中指「（成本）由己方承擔、吸收」，最接近 (B) borne（承擔）。(A) refunded（被退還）、(C) postponed（被延後）、(D) waived（被免除）皆與原意不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 財務情境中 absorb a cost／bear a cost 皆表示「承擔成本」，為常見同義替換組合。
explanation.similarNote: "absorbed"、"borne"、"shouldered" 皆可表示「承擔（費用/責任）」，可整理為同一組財務詞彙。

sections.part: Part 5：單句文法與字彙填空（15 題）

questions.stem: The retail chain's new loyalty program was ______ successful that membership doubled within two months.

explanation.title: so...that 句型
explanation.analysis: **so + 形容詞/副詞 + that** 表示「如此…以致於…」，空格後為形容詞 successful，須用 so。(B) such 須接「such + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that」，其後若無名詞則不可用 such；(C) too 表示「太…以致於不能」，後方通常接 to V 而非 that 子句，且語意為負面結果，與句意不合；(D) very 只能修飾原級形容詞，無法與 that 子句構成因果句型。
explanation.grammarPoint: so...that 與 such...that 的結構差異（so + adj/adv vs. such + (a/an) + adj + N）。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中另有一題（題目 13）同樣測試 so/such 的辨析，但該題空格後為形容詞 visible 而非名詞，判斷原則相同：若後方緊接的是形容詞或副詞，一律用 so，不可誤選 such。

questions.stem: Store managers, ______ names appear on the attached list, must attend Saturday's promotional training.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞（所有格）
explanation.analysis: 空格後方為名詞 names，且 names 是指「店經理的名字」，句子隱含「their names」的所有關係，須用**所有格關係代名詞** whose。(A) who 為主格，後面不可直接接名詞；(B) which 雖可指物，但同樣不可直接接名詞作所有格用法；(D) that 亦為主格/受格關代，無所有格用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: whose 用於先行詞與空格後名詞構成「所有」關係，無論先行詞為人或物皆可使用。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有多題測試「先行詞, ______ 動詞...」的一般主格關代用法（如 handbook, which was distributed...），本題刻意改考所有格關代 whose，須注意空格後方緊接名詞、而非動詞，是辨識所有格關代的關鍵線索。

questions.stem: The advertising agency had the storefront display ______ before the weekend sale began.

explanation.title: 使役動詞（have + O + p.p.）
explanation.analysis: **have + 受詞 + 過去分詞**表示「請人做某事／使某事被完成」，storefront display 與 redesign 為**被動關係**（展示櫥窗被重新設計），故選 redesigned。(A) redesign 為原形動詞，若用於 have + O + V 表示受詞主動執行該動作，但展示櫥窗不會主動「重新設計」；(C) to redesign 不符合 have 使役動詞後接原形或過去分詞的文法規則；(D) redesigning 為現在分詞，語意上不符合被動完成的情境。
explanation.grammarPoint: 使役動詞 have/make/get 後接受詞的分詞選用原則：受詞與動作為主動關係用原形動詞，被動關係用過去分詞。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已出現多題 have/make + O + V 原形的使役句型（如 make the cashiers verify），本題與題目 12 的差異在於受詞和動作之間是被動關係還是主動關係，作答時務必先判斷受詞是「執行動作」還是「被施加動作」。

questions.stem: No matter how ______ a discount the store offers, some customers still wait for the seasonal clearance.

explanation.title: no matter how 倒裝結構
explanation.analysis: **no matter how + 形容詞/副詞 + 主詞 + 動詞**表示「無論多麼…」，此處修飾的是名詞 a discount 前的性質，且句構為 how + 形容詞 + a + 名詞（generous a discount），須用**形容詞** generous。(B) generously 為副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 discount；(C) generosity 為名詞，不符合 how 後接形容詞/副詞的文法；(D) more generous 為比較級，与 no matter how 的固定用法不符（no matter how 後接原級）。
explanation.grammarPoint: no matter how + adj/adv 引導的讓步子句；how + adj + a + N 的特殊詞序。
explanation.similarNote: 此為題庫中首次出現的 no matter how 句型，與常見的 despite/although 讓步句型（如題目庫中大量出現的 Despite the... 句型）功能相近但結構不同，須特別注意 no matter how 後面要接「形容詞/副詞」而非直接接名詞片語。

questions.stem: The marketing director enjoys ______ new campaign concepts with the creative team every Monday morning.

explanation.title: 動名詞（enjoy + V-ing）
explanation.analysis: **enjoy** 為固定接**動名詞**作受詞的動詞，表示「樂於做某事」，故選 discussing。(A) discuss 為原形動詞，不可直接作 enjoy 的受詞；(B) to discuss 為不定詞，enjoy 不接不定詞；(D) discussed 為過去式/過去分詞，不符合作受詞的文法需求。
explanation.grammarPoint: enjoy、consider、suggest、avoid 等動詞後須接動名詞作受詞，不可接不定詞。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 suggest + V-ing、mind + V-ing 等動名詞受詞題型，本題以 enjoy 測試相同觀念，凡遇到「動詞 + 受詞」結構時，須先確認該動詞的固定搭配是動名詞還是不定詞。

questions.stem: Each of the regional outlets ______ required to display the same promotional banners this month.

explanation.title: 主詞動詞一致（each of + 複數名詞）
explanation.analysis: **each of + 複數名詞**作主詞時，動詞須用**單數**，因為 each 本身為單數概念，故選 is。(A) are、(C) were、(D) have been 皆為複數動詞形式，與 each 的單數性質不合；且句子語境為現在正在進行的規定（this month），過去式 were 亦不符合時態。
explanation.grammarPoint: each / every / either / neither + of + 複數名詞，動詞一律用單數。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已出現 Each applicant must submit... 等 each 作為形容詞修飾單數名詞的題型，本題改考 each of + 複數名詞的用法，兩者動詞皆須用單數，但結構不同，作答時須注意 each 後方是否接 of。

questions.stem: Had the retailer launched the campaign a week earlier, sales figures ______ considerably higher.

explanation.title: 與過去事實相反的假設語氣（省略 if 倒裝）
explanation.analysis: 句首 Had the retailer launched... 為**省略 if 的倒裝句**，等於 If the retailer had launched...，屬於**與過去事實相反**的假設語氣，主要子句須用 **would have + p.p.**，故選 would have been。(A) would be 用於與現在事實相反的假設；(B) will be 為直說語氣的未來式，不符合假設語氣；(D) had been 缺少 would，不能單獨作主要子句動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 與過去事實相反假設語氣：If S had p.p., S would have p.p.；倒裝形式 Had S p.p., S would have p.p.。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 If the company had done more research, it would have avoided... 等相同句型的一般形式，本題改為倒裝形式（省略 if，Had 提前），本質相同，須熟悉兩種呈現方式皆可能出現。

questions.stem: The window display looked ______ enough to stop passersby and draw them into the shop.

explanation.title: 詞性（形容詞修飾主詞補語）
explanation.analysis: **look + 形容詞**表示「看起來…」，look 為連綴動詞，其後須接**形容詞**作主詞補語，故選 eye-catching（醒目的、吸睛的）。(B) eye-catchingly 為副詞，不可作連綴動詞後的補語；(C) eye-catch 並非正確詞形；(D) eye-catchers 為名詞複數，雖文法上可作補語，但語意為「某些吸引目光的人/物」，與句意「展示看起來很醒目」不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: look / seem / appear / become 等連綴動詞後接形容詞作主詞補語，不可用副詞。
explanation.similarNote: 此為題庫中首次以 look + adj 測試連綴動詞句型，觀念與一般「主詞 + be動詞 + 形容詞」相同，須注意連綴動詞之後一律接形容詞，而非副詞。

questions.stem: Customers may pay either by credit card ______ through the store's mobile payment app.

explanation.title: 對等連接詞（either...or）
explanation.analysis: 固定搭配 **either...or...**表示「不是…就是…」，句中已出現 either，後方須搭配 **or** 呼應，故選 C。(A) but、(B) nor、(D) so 皆無法與 either 搭配構成正確的對等連接詞組合（nor 須搭配 neither）。
explanation.grammarPoint: either...or / neither...nor 為固定搭配，不可混用。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 not only...but also 的對等連接詞題型，本題改考 either...or，作答原則相同：看到句中已出現的關聯詞，即可鎖定唯一能與之呼應的另一半。

questions.stem: The store manager herself ______ greeted the visiting executives during the flagship opening.

explanation.title: 反身代名詞（強調用法）
explanation.analysis: 此處 herself 緊接在主詞 the store manager 之後，作**強調用法**，表示「店經理本人親自」，故選 herself。(A) she 為主格，重複使用主詞不合文法；(B) hers 為所有格代名詞，語意不合；(D) her own 表示「她自己的（所有物）」，通常後接名詞，不能單獨作強調主詞的用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 反身代名詞的強調用法：主詞/受詞 + 反身代名詞，用來強調「本人親自」。
explanation.similarNote: 此為題庫中首次測試反身代名詞的強調用法，與反身代名詞作受詞的一般用法（如 pride oneself on）不同，須注意此處 herself 並非作受詞，而是緊跟在名詞後方加強語氣。

questions.stem: The seasonal catalog, ______ features this year's holiday collection, will be mailed to loyalty members next week.

explanation.title: 關係代名詞（非限定用法）
explanation.analysis: 空格前有逗號，引導**非限定用法**的關係子句，先行詞 the seasonal catalog 為物，且子句中缺少主詞，須用**主格關係代名詞** which。(A) it 為代名詞，不能引導子句；(B) what 本身已包含先行詞，不可再接先行詞使用；(D) whom 為受格關代且只能指人，皆不符合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 非限定用法關係子句（逗號 + which/who），先行詞為物時用 which。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「先行詞, ______ 動詞...」的非限定關代題型在題庫中已多次出現（如 handbook, which was distributed），屬於重複度高的核心考點，須熟記逗號後先行詞為物一律用 which，不可用 that。

questions.stem: The regional supervisor made the cashiers ______ every discount code twice before finalizing a transaction.

explanation.title: 使役動詞（make + O + V 原形）
explanation.analysis: **make + 受詞 + 原形動詞**表示「使／讓某人做某事」，收銀員與 verify 為**主動關係**（收銀員主動核對折扣碼），故選原形動詞 verify。(B) to verify 不符合 make 使役動詞後接原形動詞的文法；(C) verifying 為現在分詞；(D) verified 為過去分詞，皆不符合此使役句型的固定用法。
explanation.grammarPoint: 使役動詞 make/have/let 後接受詞 + 原形動詞，表示主動去做某動作。
explanation.similarNote: 本題與題目 3 皆測試使役動詞句型，但題目 3 的受詞與動作為被動關係（須用過去分詞），本題受詞主動執行動作（須用原形動詞），兩題並列可作為對照練習，判斷關鍵在受詞與動作間是主動還是被動。

questions.stem: The new signage is ______ visible from the parking lot that shoppers can locate the entrance easily.

explanation.title: so...that 句型（形容詞在前）
explanation.analysis: **so + 形容詞 + that**表示「如此…以致於…」，空格後為形容詞 visible，須用 so。(B) such 須接名詞（such + a/an + adj + N），此處後方無名詞可接；(C) very 只能修飾原級形容詞，無法與 that 子句形成因果關係；(D) too 表示「太…而不能」，通常接 to V，且語意為負面阻礙，與句意（招牌明顯到讓顧客容易找到入口）不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: so + adj + that 子句表示「如此…以致於」的因果句型。
explanation.similarNote: 本題與題目 1 為同類型的 so/such 辨析題，皆測試「so 後方接形容詞、such 後方須接名詞」的核心原則，兩題並列有助於加深印象，避免只記住表面上的「so 或 such」而忽略後方詞性的判斷依據。

questions.stem: Customers who sign up for the rewards card ______ points toward future purchases automatically.

explanation.title: 主詞動詞一致（who 子句先行詞為複數）
explanation.analysis: who 引導的形容詞子句修飾先行詞 customers（複數），子句中缺主詞，動詞須與先行詞的**數**一致，故用複數動詞 accumulate。(A) accumulates 為單數動詞，與複數先行詞 customers 不一致；(C) accumulating 為現在分詞，不能單獨作子句的主要動詞；(D) to accumulate 為不定詞，同樣不能作子句的主要動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 關係子句中的動詞須與先行詞的單複數一致，而非與主要子句的主詞一致。
explanation.similarNote: 此類考點容易與一般主詞動詞一致的題型（如 each of + 複數名詞用單數動詞）混淆，須特別注意本題的動詞一致對象是「先行詞 customers」，而非空格所在子句以外的其他名詞。

questions.stem: The promotional flyer was distributed ______ throughout the shopping district to reach as many shoppers as possible.

explanation.title: 詞性（副詞修飾被動語態動詞）
explanation.analysis: 空格修飾被動語態動詞片語 was distributed（被分發），須用**副詞** widely（廣泛地）。(A) wide 為形容詞或作副詞使用時多指「寬」的物理距離（如 open wide），語意不符；(C) widen 為動詞，「使變寬」，不符合此處需要副詞修飾動詞的文法；(D) width 為名詞，不可修飾動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 副詞修飾被動語態動詞（be + p.p. + adv），表示動作進行的方式或程度。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 track their shipments conveniently、proceeded smoothly 等副詞修飾動詞的題型，本題延續相同考點，差異在於本題修飾的是被動語態動詞，須注意副詞在被動語態中通常置於過去分詞之後。

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文一：門市促銷公告
sections.passage:
To: All Store Staff
From: Retail Operations
Subject: Spring Clearance Event

We are excited to announce that our annual spring clearance event will begin this Saturday. All ______ (16) items will be marked down by up to 40 percent, and additional discounts will apply to customers using the store loyalty app.

Staff should arrive thirty minutes early on Saturday to reorganize the sales floor. ______ (17), extra cashiers will be scheduled during peak hours to keep checkout lines moving smoothly.

**(18)** ______

Please remind customers that clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. If you have any questions about pricing or promotional signage, contact the operations office ______ (19) the main phone line.

Thank you for helping make this event a success.

questions.stem: 題目 16

explanation.title: 分詞作形容詞（過去分詞修飾名詞）
explanation.analysis: All ______ items 中，空格修飾名詞 items，且商品與「挑選」之間為**被動關係**（被挑選出來的商品），須用**過去分詞** selected。(A) select 為原形動詞，不可單獨修飾名詞；(B) selects 為第三人稱單數動詞，不可作形容詞使用；(D) selecting 為現在分詞，表示主動進行的動作，與商品被動被挑選的語意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: 過去分詞作形容詞，修飾與其為被動關係的名詞。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 staff members currently working、the invoice sent to the wrong department 等分詞修飾名詞的題型，判斷原則相同：先確認名詞與該動作是主動還是被動關係，再決定用現在分詞或過去分詞。

questions.stem: 題目 17

explanation.title: 語意連接詞（附加語意）
explanation.analysis: 前句說明員工須提前到場整理賣場，後句補充「將加派收銀人員」，兩句之間為**附加、補充**關係，須用 **In addition**（此外）。(B) Otherwise 表示「否則」，為條件對比關係；(C) For instance 表示「例如」，為舉例關係；(D) Nevertheless 表示「儘管如此」，為轉折關係，皆不符合此處單純補充說明的語意。
explanation.grammarPoint: In addition / Otherwise / For instance / Nevertheless 等連接副詞的語意區分。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有測試 However（轉折）與 Therefore（因果）的連接詞題型，本題改考 In addition 的附加語意，作答時須先判斷前後兩句之間究竟是因果、轉折、舉例還是單純補充的關係。

questions.stem: 題目 18：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: Our company was founded in a small downtown storefront over thirty years ago.
Managers should also confirm that all clearance racks are clearly labeled before opening.
The marketing team recently redesigned the store's website homepage.
Customer satisfaction scores rose significantly after last year's holiday season.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文談的是員工提前到場整理賣場、加派收銀人員因應人潮，接續句子應與**開店前的準備事項**相關，故選 (B)「經理也應確認所有出清架標示清楚」，承接上文的整理賣場主題。(A) 談公司歷史，與促銷公告無關；(C) 談網站改版，離題；(D) 談顧客滿意度分數，與本文情境不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: Part 6 選句題須掌握上下文的主題延續性，而非僅看單句是否文法正確。
explanation.similarNote: 此類選句題在題庫中已多次出現（如公司內部公告、電子郵件），共同原則是：正確答案必須緊密銜接前後文的具體主題，而非只是泛泛相關的公司資訊。

questions.stem: 題目 19

explanation.title: 介系詞（聯絡方式）
explanation.analysis: 表示「透過某種方式聯繫」，固定用法為 contact + 對象 + **by** + 聯絡工具（如 by phone），故選 by。(A) at 通常用於接續分機號碼（at extension），不用於接續 phone line；(B) on 與 (D) with 皆不能與「主要電話線」構成此固定搭配。
explanation.grammarPoint: by + 聯絡方式（by phone、by email）為固定介系詞搭配。
explanation.similarNote:
題庫中已有 contact the facilities office at extension 245 的題型，須注意 at 用於接續「分機號碼」，而 by 用於接續「聯絡方式/工具」，兩者介系詞不可混用。

### 短文二：客戶關係電子郵件

sections.part: Part 6：短文填空（2 篇，每篇 4 題）
sections.title: 短文二：客戶關係電子郵件
sections.passage:
Dear Valued Member,

Thank you for being a loyal customer of our rewards program. We would like to let you know that starting next month, members will be able to redeem points for ______ (20) a wider selection of merchandise, including gift cards and exclusive early access to new arrivals.

To celebrate this update, your account ______ (21) an extra 500 bonus points, which will be applied automatically before the end of this week.

**(22)** ______

If you would like to review your current point balance or update your contact information, please log in to your account on our website. We appreciate your continued support and look forward to serving you.

Warm regards,
Customer Relations Team

questions.stem: 題目 20

explanation.title: 比較級的強調用法
explanation.analysis: 修飾比較級 a wider selection，須用可修飾比較級的副詞 **much**（…得多）。(A) far 雖然也可修飾比較級（far more），但此處後方為「a wider selection」，much wider 為更常見且自然的固定搭配；(C) very 只能修飾原級形容詞，不能修飾比較級；(D) most 為最高級用法，與句中的比較級 wider 不搭配。
explanation.grammarPoint: much / a lot / even + 比較級，用來加強比較級的程度。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 much higher than last year's 的比較級強調題型，本題選項刻意加入 far 作為干擾選項，須注意雖然 far 也能修飾比較級，但在固定搭配 a much wider selection 中以 much 更為常見自然。

questions.stem: 題目 21

explanation.title: 時態（未來被動式）
explanation.analysis: 句意為「你的帳戶『將會』被加值 500 點」，動作尚未發生但即將完成，且帳戶與「加值點數」為**被動關係**，須用**未來被動式** will be credited。(A) credit 為原形動詞，未表達被動或未來語意；(B) credits 為現在式主動動詞，與帳戶被動接受點數的語意不合；(D) crediting 為現在分詞，不能單獨作句子的主要動詞。
explanation.grammarPoint: 未來被動式：will be + p.p.，表示未來將發生的被動動作。
explanation.similarNote: 題庫中已有 will be moved up、was distributed 等被動語態題型，本題結合未來式與被動語態，須注意當主詞是動作的承受者且動作尚未發生時，須用 will be + p.p. 的形式。

questions.stem: 題目 22：選出最適合插入的句子

options.text: Our flagship store will be closed for renovations next month.
This gesture is our way of thanking you for your continued loyalty.
The company plans to expand into three new international markets.
Membership fees will increase slightly starting next year.

explanation.title: 選出最適合插入的句子
explanation.analysis: 上下文提到「加碼贈送 500 點以慶祝此次更新」，接續句子應說明**贈點的用意**，故選 (B)「這是我們感謝您持續支持的方式」，承接上文的感謝語氣。(A) 談門市裝修，離題；(C) 談國際市場擴張，與客戶個人權益無關；(D) 談會費調漲，與本文獎勵會員的正面語氣矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: Part 6 選句題須留意文章整體語氣（感謝、致歉、提醒等），選項須與該語氣一致。
explanation.similarNote: 此類選句題須特別注意語氣是否一致，例如本文為正面感謝信，若選項出現負面消息（如漲價、店面關閉）即可直接排除，此判斷技巧與其他選句題相通。

questions.stem: 題目 23

explanation.title: 介系詞（固定搭配 log in to）
explanation.analysis: 文中 log in **to** your account 為固定片語，表示「登入帳戶」。(A) at、(C) on、(D) with 皆不能與 log in 構成此固定搭配，故選 (B) 對應原文中 to 的用法（此處測試的是段落中 to your account 的介系詞選用）。
explanation.grammarPoint: log in to / sign in to 為固定片語，表示「登入」。
explanation.similarNote: 此類固定片語介系詞題型在題庫中已有 in advance、at extension 等例子，須熟記常見商務情境的介系詞固定搭配，而非單純依賴中文語感判斷。

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章一：品牌活動新聞稿
sections.passage:
**Riverside Outfitters Launches "Wear It Forward" Campaign**

Riverside Outfitters, a regional outdoor apparel retailer, announced today the launch of its "Wear It Forward" campaign, a month-long initiative encouraging customers to trade in gently used clothing for store credit. Beginning this Friday, shoppers who bring in at least two used garments to any Riverside Outfitters location will receive a $10 store credit per item, redeemable toward any purchase in-store or online.

The donated clothing will be cleaned, repaired if necessary, and distributed to local community shelters through a partnership with the nonprofit organization CityCare Network. According to the company's marketing director, the campaign was designed both to reduce textile waste and to strengthen the brand's connection with environmentally conscious customers.

In addition to the trade-in offer, Riverside Outfitters will run a series of in-store events throughout the campaign, including styling workshops and a raffle for shoppers who participate in the donation program. Customers interested in learning more can visit the company's website or speak with a sales associate at their nearest location.

The campaign will run through the end of next month, after which the company plans to evaluate its impact before deciding whether to make it an annual event.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the "Wear It Forward" campaign?

options.text: To promote a new clothing line
To encourage customers to trade in used clothing for store credit
To announce the opening of a new store location
To introduce a new online shopping platform

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭即說明 Riverside Outfitters...announced today the launch of its "Wear It Forward" campaign...encouraging customers to trade in gently used clothing for store credit，故答案為 (B)。(A) 新服裝系列、(C) 新店面開幕、(D) 新線上購物平台皆未在文中提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 主旨題須聚焦文章首段的核心宣告句。
explanation.similarNote: 與題庫中其他主旨題（如徵才廣告、產品發表公告）解題原則相同：答案通常直接對應首段點出的宣告目的，須避免被文章中段的細節資訊誤導。

questions.stem: According to the article, what will happen to the donated clothing?

options.text: It will be resold at a discount in stores.
It will be shipped to the company's headquarters.
It will be cleaned and given to community shelters.
It will be recycled into new store packaging.

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 The donated clothing will be cleaned, repaired if necessary, and distributed to local community shelters，故答案為 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 皆為文中未提及的推測內容。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須在文中找到與選項對應的具體句子，逐一比對。
explanation.similarNote: 此類細節題常見於徵才廣告、通知信等文章類型，作答技巧一致：先定位關鍵字（如 donated clothing），再回文中找出對應句子確認答案。

questions.stem: What additional activity is mentioned as part of the campaign?

options.text: Free shipping on all online orders

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 Riverside Outfitters will run a series of in-store events throughout the campaign, including styling workshops and a raffle，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須注意題目關鍵字（additional activity）與文中對應段落的呼應。
explanation.similarNote: 與題目 25 同屬細節查找題，皆須先鎖定題目的關鍵詞彙，再到文章對應段落中尋找精確對應的資訊，避免自行推論文章未提及的內容。

questions.stem: What will the company likely do after the campaign ends?

options.text: Evaluate the campaign's impact before deciding on future plans
Immediately launch a second, larger campaign
Discontinue its partnership with CityCare Network

explanation.title: 推論題
explanation.analysis: 文末提到 after which the company plans to evaluate its impact before deciding whether to make it an annual event，故答案為 (B)「評估活動成效後再決定未來計畫」。(A) 永久關閉店面、(C) 立即推出更大型活動、(D) 終止與 CityCare Network 的合作，文中均未提及或與原文矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: 推論題須根據文章明確陳述的資訊進行合理推論，而非天馬行空的臆測。
explanation.similarNote:
推論題容易與細節題混淆，差異在於推論題的答案不會逐字出現在文中，但仍必須有文章依據可支持，作答時應避免選擇文章完全未提及方向的選項。

### 文章二：門市經理內部備忘錄

sections.part: Part 7：篇章閱讀（2 篇）
sections.title: 文章二：門市經理內部備忘錄
sections.passage:
To: All Assistant Managers
From: District Manager, Sarah Nguyen
Subject: Updated Customer Complaint Procedure

As part of our ongoing effort to improve customer satisfaction, we are introducing a revised procedure for handling in-store complaints, effective immediately.

When a customer raises a concern, the assistant manager on duty should first listen to the full complaint before offering a solution. If the issue involves a product defect, the customer should be offered a full refund or exchange, whichever they prefer. If the complaint involves service quality, the assistant manager should document the details in the new Customer Feedback Log located at the service counter.

All complaints must be logged within 24 hours, regardless of how minor they may seem. This information will be reviewed weekly by the regional office to identify recurring issues and improve staff training. Assistant managers are also asked to follow up with customers who provided contact information, within three business days of the original complaint, to confirm that the issue was resolved to their satisfaction.

Please review this procedure with your team during your next staff meeting. If you have questions about specific cases, feel free to contact the district office directly.

Thank you for your continued commitment to excellent customer service.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this memo?

options.text: To announce a new employee benefits package
To introduce an updated procedure for handling customer complaints
To request feedback on a proposed store renovation
To remind staff of upcoming holiday store hours

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 文章開頭說明 we are introducing a revised procedure for handling in-store complaints, effective immediately，故答案為 (B)。(A) 員工福利方案、(C) 店面翻修意見調查、(D) 假期營業時間提醒，皆與本文主旨不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: 備忘錄類文章的主旨通常在首段的 Subject 或第一句明確點出。
explanation.similarNote: 與其他內部公告類文章（如辦公室翻修通知、績效考核備忘錄）相同，主旨題答案多可直接對應信件標題（Subject）與首段內容。

questions.stem: According to the memo, what should an assistant manager do first when a customer raises a concern?

options.text: Listen to the full complaint before offering a solution
Ask the customer to fill out a survey

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中明確指出 the assistant manager on duty should first listen to the full complaint before offering a solution，故答案為 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 皆為文中未提及或順序錯置的選項。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須注意題目中的順序詞（first）與文章對應的動作順序。
explanation.similarNote: 此類「首先應如何處理」的細節題須特別留意文章中表示先後順序的詞語（first、before、after），避免將後續步驟誤認為第一步驟。

questions.stem: How soon must all complaints be logged?

options.text: By the end of the month

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 All complaints must be logged within 24 hours, regardless of how minor they may seem，故答案為 (A)。(B)(C)(D) 為文中其他時間點的干擾選項（如三個工作天內回訪客戶），須注意區分不同動作對應的不同期限。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題常設計多個時間點作為干擾選項，須仔細比對題目詢問的是哪一個動作的期限。
explanation.similarNote: 本文同時出現「24 小時內登錄」與「三個工作天內回訪」兩個時間點，此類多時間點細節題須逐一對應題目詢問的具體動作，不可混淆。

questions.stem: What are assistant managers asked to do for customers who provided contact information?

options.text: Follow up within three business days to confirm resolution
Invite them to a customer appreciation event
Transfer their case to the regional office

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文中提到 Assistant managers are also asked to follow up with customers who provided contact information, within three business days of the original complaint, to confirm that the issue was resolved to their satisfaction，故答案為 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中皆未提及。
explanation.grammarPoint: 細節題須完整比對題目條件（提供聯絡資訊的顧客）與文章描述是否一致。
explanation.similarNote: 與題目 30 皆考時間相關的細節，此題進一步要求辨識題目條件「提供聯絡資訊的顧客」，須注意題目附加條件是否與文章描述完全吻合，才能避免誤選其他時間點的選項。
